data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=11","body":"Verily! Those who brought forth the slander (against 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet SAW) are a group among you. Consider it not a bad thing for you. Nay, it is good for you. Unto every man among them will be paid that which he had earned of the sin, and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be a great torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Noor","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌۭ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّۭا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/38?startingVerse=38","body":"And also others bound in fetters.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saad","reference":"Ayah 38","secondaryText":"وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=2","body":"So travel freely (O Mushrikun - see V. 2:105) for four months (as you will) throughout the land, but know that you cannot escape (from the Punishment of) Allah, and Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 2","secondaryText":"فَسِيحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْزِى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=16","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW to these hypocrites who ask your permission to run away from you): \"Flight will not avail you if you flee from death or killing, and then you will enjoy no more than a little while!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَوِ ٱلْقَتْلِ وَإِذًۭا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=29","body":"Then, when Musa (Moses) had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his family, he saw a fire in the direction of Tur (Mount). He said to his family: \"Wait, I have seen a fire; perhaps I may bring to you from there some information, or a burning fire-brand that you may warm yourselves.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 29","secondaryText":"۞ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِۦٓ ءَانَسَ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ نَارًۭا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/64?startingVerse=6","body":"That was because there came to them their Messengers with clear proofs (signs), but they said: \"Shall mere men guide us?\" So they disbelieved and turned away (from the truth), and Allah was not in need (of them). And Allah is Rich (Free of all wants), Worthy of all praise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Taghaabun","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌۭ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/36?startingVerse=44","body":"Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yaseen","reference":"Ayah 44","secondaryText":"إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/15?startingVerse=73","body":"So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry, etc.) overtook them at the time of sunrise;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hijr","reference":"Ayah 73","secondaryText":"فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=31","body":"They indeed are losers who denied their Meeting with Allah, until all of a sudden, the Hour (signs of death) is on them, and they say: \"Alas for us that we gave no thought to it,\" while they will bear their burdens on their backs; and evil indeed are the burdens that they will bear!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ يَٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ ۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=170","body":"O mankind! Verily, there has come to you the Messenger (Muhammad SAW) with the truth from your Lord, so believe in him, it is better for you. But if you disbelieve, then certainly to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 170","secondaryText":"يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا لَّكُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=36","body":"Allah said: \"You are granted your request, O Musa (Moses)!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 36","secondaryText":"قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=72","body":"And a party of the people of the Scripture say: \"Believe in the morning in that which is revealed to the believers (Muslims), and reject it at the end of the day, so that they may turn back.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 72","secondaryText":"وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=53","body":"They said: \"O Hud! No evidence have you brought us, and we shall not leave our gods for your (mere) saying! And we are not believers in you.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 53","secondaryText":"قَالُوا۟ يَٰهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍۢ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِىٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/47?startingVerse=13","body":"And many a town, stronger than your town (Makkah) (O Muhammad SAW) which has driven you out We have destroyed. And there was none to help them.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Muhammad","reference":"Ayah 13","secondaryText":"وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةًۭ مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=33","body":"And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and to whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: \"He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 33","secondaryText":"وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/38?startingVerse=16","body":"They say: \"Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittana (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we see it) before the Day of Reckoning!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saad","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=2","body":"By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 2","secondaryText":"فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=78","body":"And his people came rushing towards him, and since aforetime they used to commit crimes (sodomy, etc.), he said: \"O my people! Here are my daughters (i.e. the daughters of my nation), they are purer for you (if you marry them lawfully). So fear Allah and degrade me not as regards my guests! Is there not among you a single right-minded man?\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 78","secondaryText":"وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌۭ رَّشِيدٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=71","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Tell me! If Allah made night continuous for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is an ilah (a god) besides Allah who could bring you light? Will you not then hear?\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 71","secondaryText":"قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍ ۖ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/82?startingVerse=16","body":"And they (Al-Fujjar) will not be absent therefrom (i.e. will not go out from the Hell).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Infitaar","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/59?startingVerse=10","body":"And those who came after them say: \"Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who have preceded us in Faith, and put not in our hearts any hatred against those who have believed. Our Lord! You are indeed full of kindness, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hashr","reference":"Ayah 10","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=59","body":"Yes! Verily, there came to you My Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and you denied them, and were proud and were among the disbelievers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 59","secondaryText":"بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=33","body":"And stay in your houses, and do not display yourselves like that of the times of ignorance, and perform As-Salat (IqamatasSalat), and give Zakat and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah wishes only to remove ArRijs (evil deeds and sins, etc.) from you, O members of the family (of the Prophet SAW), and to purify you with a thorough purification.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 33","secondaryText":"وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَأَقِمْنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=62","body":"They assign to Allah that which they dislike (for themselves), and their tongues assert the falsehood that the better things will be theirs. No doubt for them is the Fire, and they will be the first to be hastened on into it, and left there neglected. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 10, Page 121)","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 62","secondaryText":"وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=23","body":"Two men of those who feared (Allah and) on whom Allah had bestowed His Grace [they were Yusha' (Joshua) and Kalab (Caleb)] said: \"Assault them through the gate, for when you are in, victory will be yours, and put your trust in Allah if you are believers indeed.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَٰلِبُونَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=104","body":"Let there arise out of you a group of people inviting to all that is good (Islam), enjoining Al-Ma'ruf (i.e. Islamic Monotheism and all that Islam orders one to do) and forbidding Al-Munkar (polytheism and disbelief and all that Islam has forbidden). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=23","body":"And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him. And that you be dutiful to your parents. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=53","body":"And whatever of blessings and good things you have, it is from Allah. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=32","body":"And those who disbelieve say: \"Why is not the Quran revealed to him all at once?\" Thus (it is sent down in parts), that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages. (It was revealed to the Prophet SAW in 23 years.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Furqaan","reference":"Ayah 32","secondaryText":"وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=6","body":"That is because Allah, He is the Truth, and it is He Who gives life to the dead, and it is He Who is Able to do all things.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=87","body":"He said: \"As for him (a disbeliever in the Oneness of Allah) who does wrong, we shall punish him; and then he will be brought back unto his Lord; Who will punish him with a terrible torment (Hell).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 87","secondaryText":"قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=59","body":"And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 59","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=2","body":"We have not sent down the Quran unto you (O Muhammad SAW) to cause you distress,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 2","secondaryText":"مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/73?startingVerse=12","body":"Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muzzammil","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=51","body":"And when We show favour to man, he withdraws and turns away, but when evil touches him, then he has recourse to long supplications.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Fussilat","reference":"Ayah 51","secondaryText":"وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/46?startingVerse=24","body":"Then, when they saw it as a dense cloud coming towards their valleys, they said: \"This is a cloud bringing us rain!\" Nay, but it is that (torment) which you were asking to be hastened! a wind wherein is a painful torment!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahqaf","reference":"Ayah 24","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًۭا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا عَارِضٌۭ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ رِيحٌۭ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/52?startingVerse=27","body":"\"But Allah has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tur","reference":"Ayah 27","secondaryText":"فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/69?startingVerse=25","body":"But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: \"I wish that I had not been given my Record!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Haaqqa","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=39","body":"And (We destroyed also) Qarun (Korah), Fir'aun (Pharaoh), and Haman. And indeed Musa (Moses) came to them with clear Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), but they were arrogant in the land, yet they could not outstrip Us (escape Our punishment).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 39","secondaryText":"وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=88","body":"And invoke not any other ilah (god) along with Allah, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). Everything will perish save His Face. His is the Decision, and to Him you (all) shall be returned.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 88","secondaryText":"وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۘ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُۥ ۚ لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=22","body":"And let not those among you who are blessed with graces and wealth swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kinsmen, Al-Masakin (the poor), and those who left their homes for Allah's Cause. Let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Noor","reference":"Ayah 22","secondaryText":"وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=100","body":"And the first to embrace Islam of the Muhajirun (those who migrated from Makkah to Al-Madinah) and the Ansar (the citizens of Al-Madinah who helped and gave aid to the Muhajirun) and also those who followed them exactly (in Faith). Allah is well-pleased with them as they are well-pleased with Him. He has prepared for them Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme success.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 100","secondaryText":"وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ وَٱلْأَنصَارِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُم بِإِحْسَٰنٍۢ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى تَحْتَهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=41","body":"\"And O my people! How is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 41","secondaryText":"۞ وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/74?startingVerse=31","body":"And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire, and We have fixed their number (19) only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may arrive at a certainty [that this Quran is the truth as it agrees with their Books i.e. their number (19) is written in the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] and the believers may increase in Faith (as this Quran is the truth) and that no doubts may be left for the people of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy) and the disbelievers may say: \"What Allah intends by this (curious) example?\" Thus Allah leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this (Hell) is nothing else than a (warning) reminder to mankind.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muddaththir","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=12","body":"In that which your wives leave, your share is a half if they have no child; but if they leave a child, you get a fourth of that which they leave after payment of legacies that they may have bequeathed or debts. In that which you leave, their (your wives) share is a fourth if you leave no child; but if you leave a child, they get an eighth of that which you leave after payment of legacies that you may have bequeathed or debts. If the man or woman whose inheritance is in question has left neither ascendants nor descendants, but has left a brother or a sister, each one of the two gets a sixth; but if more than two, they share in a third; after payment of lagacies he (or she) may have bequeathed or debts, so that no loss is caused (to anyone). This is a Commandment from Allah; and Allah is Ever All-Knowing, Most-Forbearing.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"۞ وَلَكُمْ نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ أَزْوَٰجُكُمْ إِن لَّمْ يَكُن لَّهُنَّ وَلَدٌۭ ۚ فَإِن كَانَ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌۭ فَلَكُمُ ٱلرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْنَ ۚ مِنۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍۢ يُوصِينَ بِهَآ أَوْ دَيْنٍۢ ۚ وَلَهُنَّ ٱلرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ إِن لَّمْ يَكُن لَّكُمْ وَلَدٌۭ ۚ فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌۭ فَلَهُنَّ ٱلثُّمُنُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُم ۚ مِّنۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍۢ تُوصُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ دَيْنٍۢ ۗ وَإِن كَانَ رَجُلٌۭ يُورَثُ كَلَٰلَةً أَوِ ٱمْرَأَةٌۭ وَلَهُۥٓ أَخٌ أَوْ أُخْتٌۭ فَلِكُلِّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا ٱلسُّدُسُ ۚ فَإِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ فَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فِى ٱلثُّلُثِ ۚ مِنۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍۢ يُوصَىٰ بِهَآ أَوْ دَيْنٍ غَيْرَ مُضَآرٍّۢ ۚ وَصِيَّةًۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=164","body":"Say: \"Shall I seek a lord other than Allah, while He is the Lord of all things? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=125","body":"Invite (mankind, O Muhammad SAW) to the Way of your Lord (i.e. Islam) with wisdom (i.e. with the Divine Inspiration and the Quran) and fair preaching, and argue with them in a way that is better. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=92","body":"And this (the Quran) is a blessed Book which We have sent down, confirming (the revelations) which came before it, so that you may warn the Mother of Towns (i.e. Makkah) and all those around it. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=22","body":"\"And this is the past favour with which you reproach me, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 22","secondaryText":"وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/19?startingVerse=11","body":"Then he came out to his people from Al-Mihrab (a praying place or a private room, etc.), he told them by signs to glorify Allah's Praises in the morning and in the afternoon.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Maryam","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=152","body":"And those who believe in Allah and His Messengers and make no distinction between any of them (Messengers), We shall give them their rewards, and Allah is Ever Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 152","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ سَوْفَ يُؤْتِيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/31?startingVerse=29","body":"See you not (O Muhammad SAW) that Allah merges the night into the day (i.e. the decrease in the hours of the night are added in the hours of the day), and merges the day into the night (i.e. the decrease in the hours of day are added in the hours of night), and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course for a term appointed; and that Allah is All-Aware of what you do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Luqman","reference":"Ayah 29","secondaryText":"أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=14","body":"(Iblis) said: \"Allow me respite till the Day they are raised up (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 14","secondaryText":"قَالَ أَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=47","body":"\"So go you both to him, and say: 'Verily, we are Messengers of your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and torment them not; indeed, we have come with a sign from your Lord! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=51","body":"And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrahim (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were Well-Acquainted with him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allah, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 51","secondaryText":"۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=51","body":"Truly! Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him (Alone). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/43?startingVerse=40","body":"Can you (O Muhammad SAW) make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zukhruf","reference":"Ayah 40","secondaryText":"أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/57?startingVerse=1","body":"Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, and He is the All-Mighty, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hadid","reference":"Ayah 1","secondaryText":"سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=184","body":"[Observing Saum (fasts)] for a fixed number of days, but if any of you is ill or on a journey, the same number (should be made up) from other days. But whoever does good of his own accord, it is better for him. And that you fast, it is better for you if only you know.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 184","secondaryText":"أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ ۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍۢ فَعِدَّةٌۭ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُۥ فِدْيَةٌۭ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍۢ ۖ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًۭا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَن تَصُومُوا۟ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=36","body":"And (they) said: \"Are we going to abandon our aliha (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 36","secondaryText":"وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/8?startingVerse=13","body":"This is because they defied and disobeyed Allah and His Messenger. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/13?startingVerse=38","body":"And indeed We sent Messengers before you (O Muhammad SAW), and made for them wives and offspring. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=90","body":"They are those whom Allah had guided. So follow their guidance. Say: \"No reward I ask of you for this (the Quran). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=52","body":"And verily! This your religion (of Islamic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so keep your duty to Me.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=33","body":"It is He Who has sent His Messenger (Muhammad SAW) with guidance and the religion of truth (Islam), to make it superior over all religions even though the Mushrikun (polytheists, pagans, idolaters, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah) hate (it).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 33","secondaryText":"هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=193","body":"And if you call them to guidance, they follow you not. It is the same for you whether you call them or you keep silent.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 193","secondaryText":"وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنتُمْ صَٰمِتُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=154","body":"Then after the distress, He sent down security for you. Slumber overtook a party of you, while another party was thinking about themselves (as how to save their ownselves, ignoring the others and the Prophet SAW) and thought wrongly of Allah - the thought of ignorance. They said, \"Have we any part in the affair?\" Say you (O Muhammad SAW): \"Indeed the affair belongs wholly to Allah.\" They hide within themselves what they dare not reveal to you, saying: \"If we had anything to do with the affair, none of us would have been killed here.\" Say: \"Even if you had remained in your homes, those for whom death was decreed would certainly have gone forth to the place of their death,\" but that Allah might test what is in your breasts; and to Mahis that which was in your hearts (sins), and Allah is All-Knower of what is in (your) breasts.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 154","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْغَمِّ أَمَنَةًۭ نُّعَاسًۭا يَغْشَىٰ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنكُمْ ۖ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ ظَنَّ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ ۖ يَقُولُونَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُۥ لِلَّهِ ۗ يُخْفُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ ۖ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌۭ مَّا قُتِلْنَا هَٰهُنَا ۗ قُل لَّوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَتْلُ إِلَىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ ۖ وَلِيَبْتَلِىَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=128","body":"Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they walk? Verily, in this are signs indeed for men of understanding.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 128","secondaryText":"أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=26","body":"Then Allah did send down His Sakinah (calmness, tranquillity and reassurance, etc.) on the Messenger (Muhammad SAW), and on the believers, and sent down forces (angels) which you saw not, and punished the disbelievers. Such is the recompense of disbelievers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 26","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنزَلَ جُنُودًۭا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَعَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=101","body":"And when We change a Verse [of the Quran, i.e. cancel (abrogate) its order] in place of another, and Allah knows the best of what He sends down, they (the disbelievers) say: \"You (O Muhammad SAW) are but a Muftari! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/48?startingVerse=29","body":"Muhammad (SAW) is the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are severe against disbelievers, and merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and falling down prostrate (in prayer), seeking Bounty from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure. The mark of them (i.e. of their Faith) is on their faces (foreheads) from the traces of (their) prostration (during prayers). This is their description in the Taurat (Torah). But their description in the Injeel (Gospel) is like a (sown) seed which sends forth its shoot, then makes it strong, it then becomes thick, and it stands straight on its stem, delighting the sowers that He may enrage the disbelievers with them. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=77","body":"Have you not seen those who were told to hold back their hands (from fighting) and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), and give Zakat, but when the fighting was ordained for them, behold! a section of them fear men as they fear Allah or even more. They say: \"Our Lord! Why have you ordained for us fighting? Would that you had granted us respite for a short period?\" Say: \"Short is the enjoyment of this world. The Hereafter is (far) better for him who fears Allah, and you shall not be dealt with unjustly even equal to the Fatila (a scalish thread in the long slit of a date-stone).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 77","secondaryText":"أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ قِيلَ لَهُمْ كُفُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ يَخْشَوْنَ ٱلنَّاسَ كَخَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَشَدَّ خَشْيَةًۭ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لِمَ كَتَبْتَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْقِتَالَ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ ۗ قُلْ مَتَٰعُ ٱلدُّنْيَا قَلِيلٌۭ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لِّمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/52?startingVerse=38","body":"Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tur","reference":"Ayah 38","secondaryText":"أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=35","body":"And they say: \"We are more in wealth and in children, and we are not going to be punished.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saba","reference":"Ayah 35","secondaryText":"وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًۭا وَأَوْلَٰدًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=10","body":"And that those who believe not in the Hereafter (i.e. they disbelieve that they will be recompensed for what they did in this world, good or bad, etc.), for them We have prepared a painful torment (Hell).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Israa","reference":"Ayah 10","secondaryText":"وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=40","body":"So We punished each (of them) for his sins, of them were some on whom We sent Hasiban (a violent wind with shower of stones) [as the people of Lout (Lot)], and of them were some who were overtaken by As-Saihah [torment - awful cry, etc. (as Thamud or Shu'aib's people)], and of them were some whom We caused the earth to swallow [as Qarun (Korah)], and of them were some whom We drowned [as the people of Nuh (Noah), or Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and his people]. It was not Allah Who wronged them, but they wronged themselves.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 40","secondaryText":"فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/14?startingVerse=44","body":"And warn (O Muhammad SAW) mankind of the Day when the torment will come unto them; then the wrong-doers will say: \"Our Lord! Respite us for a little while, we will answer Your Call and follow the Messengers!\" (It will be said): \"Had you not sworn aforetime that you would not leave (the world for the Hereafter).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ibrahim","reference":"Ayah 44","secondaryText":"وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=10","body":"Whosoever desires honour, power and glory then to Allah belong all honour, power and glory [and one can get honour, power and glory only by obeying and worshipping Allah (Alone)]. To Him ascend (all) the goodly words, and the righteous deeds exalt it (the goodly words i.e. the goodly words are not accepted by Allah unless and until they are followed by good deeds), but those who plot evils, theirs will be severe torment. And the plotting of such will perish.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 10","secondaryText":"مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=31","body":"\"We have been your friends in the life of this world and are (so) in the Hereafter. Therein you shall have (all) that your inner-selves desire, and therein you shall have (all) for which you ask for.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Fussilat","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=116","body":"And they (Jews, Christians and pagans) say: Allah has begotten a son (children or offspring). Glory be to Him (Exalted be He above all that they associate with Him). Nay, to Him belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth, and all surrender with obedience (in worship) to Him.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 116","secondaryText":"وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/67?startingVerse=6","body":"And for those who disbelieve in their Lord (Allah) is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Mulk","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=219","body":"And your movements among those who fall prostrate (along with you to Allah in the five compulsory congregational prayers).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 219","secondaryText":"وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=182","body":"And all the praise and thanks be to Allah, Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 182","secondaryText":"وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/84?startingVerse=25","body":"Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Inshiqaaq","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=47","body":"They (hypocrites) say: \"We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger (Muhammad SAW), and we obey,\" then a party of them turn away thereafter, such are not believers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Noor","reference":"Ayah 47","secondaryText":"وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=178","body":"So turn (O Muhammad SAW) away from them for a while,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 178","secondaryText":"وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/32?startingVerse=14","body":"Then taste you (the torment of the Fire) because of your forgetting the Meeting of this Day of yours, (and) surely! We too will forget you, so taste you the abiding torment for what you used to do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Sajda","reference":"Ayah 14","secondaryText":"فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=107","body":"If then it gets known that these two had been guilty of sin, let two others stand forth in their places, nearest in kin from among those who claim a lawful right. Let them swear by Allah (saying): \"We affirm that our testimony is truer than that of both of them, and that we have not trespassed (the truth), for then indeed we should be of the wrong-doers.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 107","secondaryText":"فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنَّهُمَا ٱسْتَحَقَّآ إِثْمًۭا فَـَٔاخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَوْلَيَٰنِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ لَشَهَٰدَتُنَآ أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَٰدَتِهِمَا وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَآ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=249","body":"Then when Talut (Saul) set out with the army, he said: \"Verily! Allah will try you by a river. So whoever drinks thereof, he is not of me, and whoever tastes it not, he is of me, except him who takes (thereof) in the hollow of his hand.\" Yet, they drank thereof, all, except a few of them. So when he had crossed it (the river), he and those who believed with him, they said: \"We have no power this day against Jalut (Goliath) and his hosts.\" But those who knew with certainty that they were to meet their Lord, said: \"How often a small group overcame a mighty host by Allah's Leave?\" And Allah is with As-Sabirin (the patient ones, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 249","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/44?startingVerse=6","body":"(As) a Mercy from your Lord. Verily! He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ad-Dukhaan","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=17","body":"Say: \"Who is he who can protect you from Allah if He intends to harm you, or intends mercy on you?\" And they will not find, besides Allah, for themselves any Wali (protector, supporter, etc.) or any helper.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/15?startingVerse=51","body":"And tell them about the guests (the angels) of Ibrahim (Abraham).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hijr","reference":"Ayah 51","secondaryText":"وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=49","body":"This is of the news of the unseen which We reveal unto you (O Muhammad SAW), neither you nor your people knew them before this. So be patient. Surely, the (good) end is for the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2)","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 49","secondaryText":"تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَٰذَا ۖ فَٱصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=13","body":"These are the limits (set by) Allah (or ordainments as regards laws of inheritance), and whosoever obeys Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW) will be admitted to Gardens under which rivers flow (in Paradise), to abide therein, and that will be the great success.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 13","secondaryText":"تِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=79","body":"Whatever of good reaches you, is from Allah, but whatever of evil befalls you, is from yourself. And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW) as a Messenger to mankind, and Allah is Sufficient as a Witness.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 79","secondaryText":"مَّآ أَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍۢ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٍۢ فَمِن نَّفْسِكَ ۚ وَأَرْسَلْنَٰكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولًۭا ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=55","body":"So (as a result of that) they deny (with ungratefulness) that (Allah's Favours) which We have bestowed on them! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=29","body":"Verily, those who recite the Book of Allah (this Quran), and perform AsSalat (IqamatasSalat), and spend (in charity) out of what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, hope for a (sure) tradegain that will never perish.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 29","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةًۭ لَّن تَبُورَ"}

title: The Quran

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=15","body":"O mankind! it is you who stand in need of Allah, but Allah is Rich (Free of all wants and needs), Worthy of all praise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/79?startingVerse=5","body":"And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naazi'aat","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=24","body":"Also (forbidden are) women already married, except those (captives and slaves) whom your right hands possess. Thus has Allah ordained for you. All others are lawful, provided you seek (them in marriage) with Mahr (bridal money given by the husband to his wife at the time of marriage) from your property, desiring chastity, not committing illegal sexual intercourse, so with those of whom you have enjoyed sexual relations, give them their Mahr as prescribed; but if after a Mahr is prescribed, you agree mutually (to give more), there is no sin on you. Surely, Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 24","secondaryText":"۞ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْ ۖ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَأُحِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَن تَبْتَغُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُم مُّحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَٰفِحِينَ ۚ فَمَا ٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهِۦ مِنْهُنَّ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةًۭ ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا تَرَٰضَيْتُم بِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=44","body":"And the dwellers of Paradise will call out to the dwellers of the Fire (saying): \"We have indeed found true what our Lord had promised us; have you also found true, what your Lord promised (warnings, etc.)?\" They shall say: \"Yes.\" Then a crier will proclaim between them: \"The Curse of Allah is on the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.),\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 44","secondaryText":"وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ أَن قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّۭا فَهَلْ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّۭا ۖ قَالُوا۟ نَعَمْ ۚ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن لَّعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/63?startingVerse=1","body":"When the hypocrites come to you (O Muhammad SAW), they say: \"We bear witness that you are indeed the Messenger of Allah.\" Allah knows that you are indeed His Messenger and Allah bears witness that the hypocrites are liars indeed.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Munaafiqoon","reference":"Ayah 1","secondaryText":"إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/63?startingVerse=5","body":"And when it is said to them: \"Come, so that the Messenger of Allah may ask forgiveness from Allah for you\", they turn aside their heads, and you would see them turning away their faces in pride.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Munaafiqoon","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=23","body":"Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah [i.e. they have gone out for Jihad (holy fighting), and showed not their backs to the disbelievers], of them some have fulfilled their obligations (i.e. have been martyred), and some of them are still waiting, but they have never changed [i.e. they never proved treacherous to their covenant which they concluded with Allah] in the least.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌۭ صَدَقُوا۟ مَا عَٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُۥ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ ۖ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا۟ تَبْدِيلًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=163","body":"Verily, We have inspired you (O Muhammad SAW) as We inspired Nuh (Noah) and the Prophets after him; We (also) inspired Ibrahim (Abraham), Isma'il (Ishmael), Ishaque (Isaac), Ya'qub (Jacob), and Al-Asbat [the twelve sons of Ya'qub (Jacob)], 'Iesa (Jesus), Ayub (Job), Yunus (Jonah), Harun (Aaron), and Sulaiman (Solomon), and to Dawud (David) We gave the Zabur (Psalms).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 163","secondaryText":"۞ إِنَّآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ كَمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَعِيسَىٰ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَٰرُونَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/8?startingVerse=41","body":"And know that whatever of war-booty that you may gain, verily one-fifth (1/5th) of it is assigned to Allah, and to the Messenger, and to the near relatives [of the Messenger (Muhammad SAW)], (and also) the orphans, Al-Masakin (the poor) and the wayfarer, if you have believed in Allah and in that which We sent down to Our slave (Muhammad SAW) on the Day of criterion (between right and wrong), the Day when the two forces met (the battle of Badr) - And Allah is Able to do all things.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anfaal","reference":"Ayah 41","secondaryText":"۞ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُۥ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=155","body":"And Musa (Moses) chose out of his people seventy (of the best) men for Our appointed time and place of meeting, and when they were seized with a violent earthquake, he said: \"O my Lord, if it had been Your Will, You could have destroyed them and me before; would You destroy us for the deeds of the foolish ones among us? It is only Your Trial by which You lead astray whom You will, and keep guided whom You will. You are our Wali (Protector), so forgive us and have Mercy on us, for You are the Best of those who forgive.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 155","secondaryText":"وَٱخْتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوْمَهُۥ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًۭا لِّمِيقَٰتِنَا ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّٰىَ ۖ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهْدِى مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا ۖ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْغَٰفِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/45?startingVerse=12","body":"Allah it is He Who has subjected to you the sea, that ships may sail through it by His Command, and that you may seek of His Bounty, and that you may be thankful,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Jaathiya","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=53","body":"Who has made earth for you like a bed (spread out); and has opened roads (ways and paths etc.) for you therein; and has sent down water (rain) from the sky. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=166","body":"Verily, we (angels), we are they who glorify (Allah's Praises i.e. perform prayers).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 166","secondaryText":"وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=54","body":"When those who believe in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) come to you, say: \"Salamun 'Alaikum\" (peace be on you); your Lord has written Mercy for Himself, so that, if any of you does evil in ignorance, and thereafter repents and does righteous good deeds (by obeying Allah), then surely, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 54","secondaryText":"وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۖ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=26","body":"And those of the people of the Scripture who backed them (the disbelievers) Allah brought them down from their forts and cast terror into their hearts, (so that) a group (of them) you killed, and a group (of them) you made captives.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 26","secondaryText":"وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَٰهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًۭا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=49","body":"And to Allah prostate all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, of the live moving creatures and the angels, and they are not proud [i.e. they worship their Lord (Allah) with humility].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 49","secondaryText":"وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=18","body":"And of no effect is the repentance of those who continue to do evil deeds until death faces one of them and he says: \"Now I repent;\" nor of those who die while they are disbelievers. For them We have prepared a painful torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"وَلَيْسَتِ ٱلتَّوْبَةُ لِلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ إِنِّى تُبْتُ ٱلْـَٰٔنَ وَلَا ٱلَّذِينَ يَمُوتُونَ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/42?startingVerse=51","body":"It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by Inspiration, or from behind a veil, or (that) He sends a Messenger to reveal what He wills by His Leave. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/42?startingVerse=24","body":"Or say they: \"He has invented a lie against Allah?\" If Allah willed, He could have sealed your heart (so that you forget all that you know of the Quran). And Allah wipes out falsehood, and establishes the truth (Islam) by His Word (this Qur'an). Verily, He knows well what (the secrets) are in the breasts (of mankind).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shura","reference":"Ayah 24","secondaryText":"أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=25","body":"And give glad tidings to those who believe and do righteous good deeds, that for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). Every time they will be provided with a fruit therefrom, they will say: \"This is what we were provided with before,\" and they will be given things in resemblance (i.e. in the same form but different in taste) and they shall have therein Azwajun Mutahharatun (purified mates or wives), (having no menses, stools, urine, etc.) and they will abide therein forever.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍۢ رِّزْقًۭا ۙ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌۭ مُّطَهَّرَةٌۭ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/52?startingVerse=23","body":"There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vague talk between them), and free from sin (because it will be legal for them to drink).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tur","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=44","body":"Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 44","secondaryText":"بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=107","body":"And for those whose faces will become white, they will be in Allah's Mercy (Paradise), therein they shall dwell forever.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 107","secondaryText":"وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِى رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=71","body":"And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups, till, when they reach it, the gates thereof will be opened (suddenly like a prison at the arrival of the prisoners). And its keepers will say, \"Did not the Messengers come to you from yourselves, reciting to you the Verses of your Lord, and warning you of the Meeting of this Day of yours?\" They will say: \"Yes, but the Word of torment has been justified against the disbelievers!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 71","secondaryText":"وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/12?startingVerse=18","body":"And they brought his shirt stained with false blood. He said: \"Nay, but your ownselves have made up a tale. So (for me) patience is most fitting. And it is Allah (Alone) Whose help can be sought against that which you assert.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yusuf","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍۢ كَذِبٍۢ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًۭا ۖ فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌۭ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=65","body":"\"Verily! My slaves (i.e. the true believers of Islamic Monotheism), you have no authority over them. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=91","body":"I (Muhammad SAW) have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city (Makkah), Him Who has sanctified it and His is everything. And I am commanded to be from among the Muslims (those who submit to Allah in Islam).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naml","reference":"Ayah 91","secondaryText":"إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=35","body":"Say: \"Is there of your (Allah's so-called) partners one that guides to the truth?\" Say: \"It is Allah Who guides to the truth. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=4","body":"Allah has not put for any man two hearts inside his body. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=35","body":"If their aversion (from you, O Muhammad SAW and from that with which you have been sent) is hard on you, (and you cannot be patient from their harm to you), then if you were able to seek a tunnel in the ground or a ladder to the sky, so that you may bring them a sign (and you cannot do it, so be patient). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=5","body":"O mankind! If you are in doubt about the Resurrection, then verily! We have created you (i.e. Adam) from dust, then from a Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge i.e. offspring of Adam), then from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood) then from a little lump of flesh, some formed and some unformed (miscarriage), that We may make (it) clear to you (i.e. to show you Our Power and Ability to do what We will). And We cause whom We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed term, then We bring you out as infants, then (give you growth) that you may reach your age of full strength. And among you there is he who dies (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the miserable old age, so that he knows nothing after having known. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down water (rain) on it, it is stirred (to life), it swells and puts forth every lovely kind (of growth).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍۢ مُّخَلَّقَةٍۢ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍۢ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةًۭ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=82","body":"\"And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the town; and there was under it a treasure belonging to them; and their father was a righteous man, and your Lord intended that they should attain their age of full strength and take out their treasure as a mercy from your Lord. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/13?startingVerse=16","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?\" Say: \"(It is) Allah.\" Say: \"Have you then taken (for worship) Auliya' (protectors, etc.) other than Him, such as have no power either for benefit or for harm to themselves?\" Say: \"Is the blind equal to the one who sees? data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=233","body":"The mothers shall give suck to their children for two whole years, (that is) for those (parents) who desire to complete the term of suckling, but the father of the child shall bear the cost of the mother's food and clothing on a reasonable basis. No person shall have a burden laid on him greater than he can bear. No mother shall be treated unfairly on account of her child, nor father on account of his child. And on the (father's) heir is incumbent the like of that (which was incumbent on the father). If they both decide on weaning, by mutual consent, and after due consultation, there is no sin on them. And if you decide on a foster suckling-mother for your children, there is no sin on you, provided you pay (the mother) what you agreed (to give her) on reasonable basis. And fear Allah and know that Allah is All-Seer of what you do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 233","secondaryText":"۞ وَٱلْوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَٰدَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ۖ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ ٱلرَّضَاعَةَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْمَوْلُودِ لَهُۥ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَا تُضَآرَّ وَٰلِدَةٌۢ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوْلُودٌۭ لَّهُۥ بِوَلَدِهِۦ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ ۗ فَإِنْ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍۢ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا ۗ وَإِنْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن تَسْتَرْضِعُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا سَلَّمْتُم مَّآ ءَاتَيْتُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=169","body":"Then after them succeeded an (evil) generation, which inherited the Book, but they chose (for themselves) the goods of this low life (evil pleasures of this world) saying (as an excuse): \"(Everything) will be forgiven to us.\" And if (again) the offer of the like (evil pleasures of this world) came their way, they would (again) seize them (would commit those sins). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/60?startingVerse=12","body":"O Prophet! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=70","body":"And leave alone those who take their religion as play and amusement, and are deceived by the life of this world. For them will be a drink of boiling water and a painful torment because they used to disbelieve","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 70","secondaryText":"وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًۭا وَلَهْوًۭا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّۭ وَلَا شَفِيعٌۭ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍۢ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=28","body":"And keep yourself (O Muhammad SAW) patiently with those who call on their Lord (i.e. your companions who remember their Lord with glorification, praising in prayers, etc., and other righteous deeds, etc.) morning and afternoon, seeking His Face, and let not your eyes overlook them, desiring the pomp and glitter of the life of the world; and obey not him whose heart We have made heedless of Our Remembrance, one who follows his own lusts and whose affair (deeds) has been lost.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 28","secondaryText":"وَٱصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُۥ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=157","body":"Or lest you (pagan Arabs) should say: \"If only the Book had been sent down to us, we would surely have been better guided than they (Jews and Christians).\" So now has come unto you a clear proof (the Quran) from your Lord, and a guidance and a mercy. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=141","body":"Those (hyprocrites) who wait and watch about you; if you gain a victory from Allah, they say: \"Were we not with you,\" but if the disbelievers gain a success, they say (to them): \"Did we not gain mastery over you and did we not protect you from the believers?\" Allah will judge between you (all) on the Day of Resurrection. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=158","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"O mankind! Verily, I am sent to you all as the Messenger of Allah - to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He); It is He Who gives life and causes death. So believe in Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), the Prophet who can neither read nor write (i.e. Muhammad SAW) who believes in Allah and His Words [(this Quran), the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel) and also Allah's Word: \"Be!\" - and he was, i.e. 'Iesa (Jesus) son of Maryam (Mary)], and follow him so that you may be guided.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 158","secondaryText":"قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ ٱلْأُمِّىِّ ٱلَّذِى يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَٱتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=37","body":"So her Lord (Allah) accepted her with goodly acceptance.
