title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/59?startingVerse=11","body":"Have you (O Muhammad SAW) not observed the hypocrites who say to their friends among the people of the Scripture who disbelieve: \"(By Allah) If you are expelled, we (too) indeed will go out with you, and we shall never obey any one against you, and if you are attacked (in fight), we shall indeed help you.\" But Allah is Witness, that they verily, are liars.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hashr","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ أَحَدًا أَبَدًۭا وَإِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=50","body":"And (remember) when We separated the sea for you and saved you and drowned Fir'aun's (Pharaoh) people while you were looking (at them, when the sea-water covered them).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 50","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=48","body":"And We have sent down to you (O Muhammad SAW) the Book (this Quran) in truth, confirming the Scripture that came before it and Mohayminan (trustworthy in highness and a witness) over it (old Scriptures). So judge between them by what Allah has revealed, and follow not their vain desires, diverging away from the truth that has come to you. To each among you, We have prescribed a law and a clear way. If Allah willed, He would have made you one nation, but that (He) may test you in what He has given you; so strive as in a race in good deeds. The return of you (all) is to Allah; then He will inform you about that in which you used to differ.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 48","secondaryText":"وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ لِكُلٍّۢ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةًۭ وَمِنْهَاجًۭا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=17","body":"It is not for the Mushrikun (polytheists, idolaters, pagans, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah), to maintain the Mosques of Allah (i.e. to pray and worship Allah therein, to look after their cleanliness and their building, etc.), while they witness against their ownselves of disbelief. The works of such are in vain and in Fire shall they abide.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يَعْمُرُوا۟ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ شَٰهِدِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِم بِٱلْكُفْرِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ وَفِى ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=56","body":"Verily, those who dispute about the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allah, without any authority having come to them, there is nothing else in their breasts except pride [to accept you (Muhammad SAW) as a Messenger of Allah and to obey you]. They will never have it (i.e. Prophethood which Allah has bestowed upon you). So seek refuge in Allah (O Muhammad SAW from the arrogants). Verily, it is He Who is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 56","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌۭ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/98?startingVerse=7","body":"Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allah, and in His Messenger Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) including all obligations ordered by Islam] and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Bayyina","reference":"Ayah 7","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=187","body":"It is made lawful for you to have sexual relations with your wives on the night of As-Saum (the fasts). They are Libas [i.e. body cover, or screen, or Sakan, (i.e. you enjoy the pleasure of living with her - as in Verse 7:189) Tafsir At-Tabari], for you and you are the same for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He turned to you (accepted your repentance) and forgave you. So now have sexual relations with them and seek that which Allah has ordained for you (offspring), and eat and drink until the white thread (light) of dawn appears to you distinct from the black thread (darkness of night), then complete your Saum (fast) till the nightfall. And do not have sexual relations with them (your wives) while you are in I'tikaf (i.e. confining oneself in a mosque for prayers and invocations leaving the worldly activities) in the mosques. These are the limits (set) by Allah, so approach them not. Thus does Allah make clear His Ayat (proofs, evidences, lessons, signs, revelations, verses, laws, legal and illegal things, Allah's set limits, orders, etc.) to mankind that they may become Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V. 2:2).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 187","secondaryText":"أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ ٱلصِّيَامِ ٱلرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَآئِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌۭ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَٱلْـَٰٔنَ بَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَكُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ ٱلْخَيْطُ ٱلْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْطِ ٱلْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا۟ ٱلصِّيَامَ إِلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُبَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَٰكِفُونَ فِى ٱلْمَسَٰجِدِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=16","body":"And the two persons (man and woman) among you who commit illegal sexual intercourse, punish them both. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=29","body":"Nay, but those who do wrong follow their own lusts without knowledge, Then who will guide him whom Allah has sent astray? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=8","body":"Verily, in this is an Ayah (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans, etc., who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 8","secondaryText":"إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=54","body":"\"And turn in repentance and in obedience with true Faith (Islamic Monotheism) to your Lord and submit to Him, (in Islam), before the torment comes upon you, then you will not be helped.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 54","secondaryText":"وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=107","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW to them): \"Believe in it (the Quran) or do not believe (in it). Verily! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=17","body":"And you might have seen the sun, when it rose, declining to the right from their Cave, and when it set, turning away from them to the left, while they lay in the midst of the Cave. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/13?startingVerse=17","body":"He sends down water (rain) from the sky, and the valleys flow according to their measure, but the flood bears away the foam that mounts up to the surface, and (also) from that (ore) which they heat in the fire in order to make ornaments or utensils, rises a foam like unto it, thus does Allah (by parables) show forth truth and falsehood. Then, as for the foam it passes away as scum upon the banks, while that which is for the good of mankind remains in the earth. Thus Allah sets forth parables (for the truth and falsehood, i.e. Belief and disbelief).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Ra'd","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحْتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيْلُ زَبَدًۭا رَّابِيًۭا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلنَّارِ ٱبْتِغَآءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَٰعٍۢ زَبَدٌۭ مِّثْلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَٱلْبَٰطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَآءًۭ ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/42?startingVerse=48","body":"But if they turn away (O Muhammad SAW from the Islamic Monotheism, which you have brought to them). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=92","body":"It is not for a believer to kill a believer except (that it be) by mistake, and whosoever kills a believer by mistake, (it is ordained that) he must set free a believing slave and a compensation (blood money, i.e. Diya) be given to the deceased's family, unless they remit it. If the deceased belonged to a people at war with you and he was a believer; the freeing of a believing slave (is prescribed), and if he belonged to a people with whom you have a treaty of mutual alliance, compensation (blood money - Diya) must be paid to his family, and a believing slave must be freed. And whoso finds this (the penance of freeing a slave) beyond his means, he must fast for two consecutive months in order to seek repentance from Allah. And Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 92","secondaryText":"وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَن يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَـًۭٔا ۚ وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا خَطَـًۭٔا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۢ وَدِيَةٌۭ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَصَّدَّقُوا۟ ۚ فَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍ عَدُوٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۢ ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌۭ فَدِيَةٌۭ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ وَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۢ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ تَوْبَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=31","body":"And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=30","body":"And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: \"Verily, I am going to place (mankind) generations after generations on earth.\" They said: \"Will You place therein those who will make mischief therein and shed blood, - while we glorify You with praises and thanks (Exalted be You above all that they associate with You as partners) and sanctify You.\" He (Allah) said: \"I know that which you do not know.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 30","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=161","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Truly, my Lord has guided me to a Straight Path, a right religion, the religion of Ibrahim (Abraham), Hanifa [i.e. the true Islamic Monotheism - to believe in One God (Allah i.e. to worship none but Allah, Alone)] and he was not of Al-Mushrikun (see V. 2:105).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 161","secondaryText":"قُلْ إِنَّنِى هَدَىٰنِى رَبِّىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ دِينًۭا قِيَمًۭا مِّلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًۭا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/46?startingVerse=26","body":"And indeed We had firmly established them with that wherewith We have not established you (O Quraish)! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=257","body":"Allah is the Wali (Protector or Guardian) of those who believe. He brings them out from darkness into light. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=155","body":"He said: \"Here is a she-camel; it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 155","secondaryText":"قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/38?startingVerse=74","body":"Except Iblis (Satan) he was proud and was one of the disbelievers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saad","reference":"Ayah 74","secondaryText":"إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=134","body":"Whoever desires a reward in this life of the world, then with Allah (Alone and none else) is the reward of this worldly life and of the Hereafter. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=99","body":"And on that Day [i.e. the Day Ya'juj and Ma'juj (Gog and Magog) will come out], We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another, and the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 99","secondaryText":"۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=11","body":"And Allah did create you (Adam) from dust, then from Nutfah (male and female discharge semen drops i.e. Adam's offspring), then He made you pairs (male and female). And no female conceives or gives birth, but with His Knowledge. And no aged man is granted a length of life, nor is a part cut off from his life (or another man's life), but is in a Book (AlLauh AlMahfuz) Surely, that is easy for Allah.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍۢ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=114","body":"So eat of the lawful and good food which Allah has provided for you. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=33","body":"'Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens) will they enter, therein will they be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments there will be of silk (i.e. in Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 33","secondaryText":"جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=14","body":"When the Messengers came to them, from before them and behind them (saying): \"Worship none but Allah\" They said: \"If our Lord had so willed, He would surely have sent down the angels. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/79?startingVerse=32","body":"And the mountains He has fixed firmly;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naazi'aat","reference":"Ayah 32","secondaryText":"وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=16","body":"And (remember) Ibrahim (Abraham) when he said to his people: \"Worship Allah (Alone), and fear Him, that is better for you if you did but know.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=22","body":"Certainly, they are those who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 22","secondaryText":"لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=31","body":"Hunafa' Lillah (i.e. to worship none but Allah), not associating partners (in worship, etc.) unto Him and whoever assigns partners to Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky, and the birds had snatched him, or the wind had thrown him to a far off place.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍۢ سَحِيقٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=17","body":"Like this We requited them because they were ungrateful disbelievers. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=83","body":"But none believed in Musa (Moses) except the offspring of his people, because of the fear of Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, lest they should persecute them; and verily, Fir'aun (Pharaoh) was arrogant tyrant on the earth, he was indeed one of the Musrifun (polytheists, sinners and transgressors, those who give up the truth and follow the evil, and commit all kinds of great sins).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 83","secondaryText":"فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍۢ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=128","body":"And if a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part, there is no sin on them both if they make terms of peace between themselves; and making peace is better. And human inner-selves are swayed by greed. But if you do good and keep away from evil, verily, Allah is Ever Well-Acquainted with what you do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 128","secondaryText":"وَإِنِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنۢ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًۭا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ أَن يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًۭا ۚ وَٱلصُّلْحُ خَيْرٌۭ ۗ وَأُحْضِرَتِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ ٱلشُّحَّ ۚ وَإِن تُحْسِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=25","body":"And whoever of you have not the means wherewith to wed free, believing women, they may wed believing girls from among those (captives and slaves) whom your right hands possess, and Allah has full knowledge about your Faith, you are one from another. Wed them with the permission of their own folk (guardians, Auliya' or masters) and give them their Mahr according to what is reasonable; they (the above said captive and slave-girls) should be chaste, not adulterous, nor taking boy-friends. And after they have been taken in wedlock, if they commit illegal sexual intercourse, their punishment is half that for free (unmarried) women. This is for him among you who is afraid of being harmed in his religion or in his body; but it is better for you that you practise self-restraint, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"وَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنكُمْ طَوْلًا أَن يَنكِحَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ فَمِن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُم مِّن فَتَيَٰتِكُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَٰنِكُم ۚ بَعْضُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ فَٱنكِحُوهُنَّ بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهِنَّ وَءَاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ مُحْصَنَٰتٍ غَيْرَ مُسَٰفِحَٰتٍۢ وَلَا مُتَّخِذَٰتِ أَخْدَانٍۢ ۚ فَإِذَآ أُحْصِنَّ فَإِنْ أَتَيْنَ بِفَٰحِشَةٍۢ فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ مَا عَلَى ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ ٱلْعَنَتَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأَن تَصْبِرُوا۟ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/66?startingVerse=1","body":"O Prophet! Why do you ban (for yourself) that which Allah has made lawful to you, seeking to please your wives? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/12?startingVerse=21","body":"And he (the man) from Egypt who bought him, said to his wife: \"Make his stay comfortable, may be he will profit us or we shall adopt him as a son.\" Thus did We establish Yusuf (Joseph) in the land, that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah has full power and control over His Affairs, but most of men know not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yusuf","reference":"Ayah 21","secondaryText":"وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=58","body":"And (remember) when We said: \"Enter this town (Jerusalem) and eat bountifully therein with pleasure and delight wherever you wish, and enter the gate in prostration (or bowing with humility) and say: 'Forgive us,' and We shall forgive you your sins and shall increase (reward) for the good-doers.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 58","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قُلْنَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًۭا وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًۭا وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌۭ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ ۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=112","body":"(The believers whose lives Allah has purchased are) those who repent to Allah (from polytheism and hypocrisy, etc.), who worship Him, who praise Him, who fast (or go out in Allah's Cause), who bow down (in prayer), who prostrate themselves (in prayer), who enjoin (people) for Al-Ma'ruf (i.e. Islamic Monotheism and all what Islam has ordained) and forbid (people) from Al-Munkar (i.e. disbelief, polytheism of all kinds and all that Islam has forbidden), and who observe the limits set by Allah (do all that Allah has ordained and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which Allah has forbidden). And give glad tidings to the believers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 112","secondaryText":"ٱلتَّٰٓئِبُونَ ٱلْعَٰبِدُونَ ٱلْحَٰمِدُونَ ٱلسَّٰٓئِحُونَ ٱلرَّٰكِعُونَ ٱلسَّٰجِدُونَ ٱلْءَامِرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱلنَّاهُونَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْحَٰفِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=152","body":"And Allah did indeed fulfil His Promise to you when you were killing them (your enemy) with His Permission; until (the moment) you lost your courage and fell to disputing about the order, and disobeyed after He showed you (of the booty) which you love. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=151","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited you from: Join not anything in worship with Him; be good and dutiful to your parents; kill not your children because of poverty - We provide sustenance for you and for them; come not near to Al-Fawahish (shameful sins, illegal sexual intercourse, etc.) whether committed openly or secretly, and kill not anyone whom Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause (according to Islamic law). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=61","body":"If you were to ask them: \"Who has created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?\" They will surely reply: \"Allah.\" How then are they deviating (as polytheists and disbelievers)?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 61","secondaryText":"وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=65","body":"And indeed it has been revealed to you (O Muhammad SAW), as it was to those (Allah's Messengers) before you: \"If you join others in worship with Allah, (then) surely (all) your deeds will be in vain, and you will certainly be among the losers.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 65","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=286","body":"Allah burdens not a person beyond his scope. He gets reward for that (good) which he has earned, and he is punished for that (evil) which he has earned. \"Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which You did lay on those before us (Jews and Christians); our Lord! Put not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Pardon us and grant us Forgiveness. Have mercy on us. You are our Maula (Patron, Suppor-ter and Protector, etc.) and give us victory over the disbelieving people.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 286","secondaryText":"لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/31?startingVerse=33","body":"O mankind! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=113","body":"Had not the Grace of Allah and His Mercy been upon you (O Muhammad SAW), a party of them would certainly have made a decision to mislead you, but (in fact) they mislead none except their own selves, and no harm can they do to you in the least. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=25","body":"Those before them belied, and so the torment came on them from directions they perceived not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=23","body":"Verily, those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, and humble themselves (in repentance and obedience) before their Lord, - they will be dwellers of Paradise to dwell therein forever.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَخْبَتُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=73","body":"So We said: \"Strike him (the dead man) with a piece of it (the cow).\" Thus Allah brings the dead to life and shows you His Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) so that you may understand.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 73","secondaryText":"فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/89?startingVerse=11","body":"Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allah).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Fajr","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/36?startingVerse=12","body":"Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before (them), and their traces [their footsteps and walking on the earth with their legs to the mosques for the five compulsory congregational prayers, Jihad (holy fighting in Allah's Cause) and all other good and evil they did, and that which they leave behind], and all things We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yaseen","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=26","body":"So Allah made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 26","secondaryText":"فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/66?startingVerse=4","body":"If you two (wives of the Prophet SAW, namely 'Aishah and Hafsah) turn in repentance to Allah, (it will be better for you), your hearts are indeed so inclined (to oppose what the Prophet SAW likes), but if you help one another against him (Muhammad SAW), then verily, Allah is his Maula (Lord, or Master, or Protector, etc.), and Jibrael (Gabriel), and the righteous among the believers, and furthermore, the angels are his helpers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tahrim","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=39","body":"\"O my people! Truly, this life of the world is nothing but a (quick passing) enjoyment, and verily, the Hereafter that is the home that will remain forever.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 39","secondaryText":"يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَٰعٌۭ وَإِنَّ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=19","body":"(Allah) said: \"Cast it down, O Musa (Moses)!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 19","secondaryText":"قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=12","body":"Then He completed and finished from their creation (as) seven heavens in two Days and He made in each heaven its affair. And We adorned the nearest (lowest) heaven with lamps (stars) to be an adornment as well as to guard (from the devils by using them as missiles against the devils). Such is the Decree of Him the All-Mighty, the All-Knower.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Fussilat","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍۢ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=12","body":"So perchance you (Muhammad SAW) may give up a part of what is revealed unto you, and that your breast feels straitened for it because they say, \"Why has not a treasure been sent down unto him, or an angel has come with him?\" But you are only a warner. And Allah is a Wakil (Disposer of affairs, Trustee, Guardian, etc.) over all things.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=66","body":"Then We drowned the others.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 66","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=92","body":"And be not like her who undoes the thread which she has spun after it has become strong, by taking your oaths a means of deception among yourselves, lest a nation may be more numerous than another nation. Allah only tests you by this [i.e. who obeys Allah and fulfills Allah's Covenant and who disobeys Allah and breaks Allah's Covenant]. And on the Day of Resurrection, He will certainly make clear to you that wherein you used to differ [i.e. a believer confesses and believes in the Oneness of Allah and in the Prophethood of Prophet Muhammad SAW which the disbeliever denies it and that was their difference amongst them in the life of this world].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 92","secondaryText":"وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَٰثًۭا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِىَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/64?startingVerse=8","body":"Therefore, believe in Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), and in the Light (this Quran) which We have sent down. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Taghaabun","reference":"Ayah 8","secondaryText":"فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=42","body":"It is Allah Who takes away the souls at the time of their death, and those that die not during their sleep. He keeps those (souls) for which He has ordained death and sends the rest for a term appointed. Verily, in this are signs for a people who think deeply.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 42","secondaryText":"ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=37","body":"\"And indeed We conferred a favour on you another time (before).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 37","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/12?startingVerse=86","body":"He said: \"I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you know not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yusuf","reference":"Ayah 86","secondaryText":"قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=184","body":"Do they not reflect? There is no madness in their companion (Muhammad SAW). He is but a plain warner.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 184","secondaryText":"أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۗ مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=54","body":"Whether you reveal anything or conceal it, verily, Allah is Ever AllKnower of everything.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 54","secondaryText":"إِن تُبْدُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/47?startingVerse=32","body":"Verily, those who disbelieve, and hinder (men) from the Path of Allah (i.e. Islam), and oppose the Messenger (SAW) (by standing against him and hurting him), after the guidance has been clearly shown to them, they will not hurt Allah in the least, but He will make their deeds fruitless,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Muhammad","reference":"Ayah 32","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=36","body":"Is not Allah Sufficient for His slave? Yet they try to frighten you with those (whom they worship) besides Him! And whom Allah sends astray, for him there will be no guide.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 36","secondaryText":"أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=162","body":"They will abide therein (under the curse in Hell), their punishment will neither be lightened, nor will they be reprieved.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 162","secondaryText":"خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=113","body":"And verily, there had come unto them a Messenger (Muhammad SAW) from among themselves, but they denied him, so the torment overtook them while they were Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 113","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=193","body":"And fight them until there is no more Fitnah (disbelief and worshipping of others along with Allah) and (all and every kind of) worship is for Allah (Alone). But if they cease, let there be no transgression except against Az-Zalimun (the polytheists, and wrong-doers, etc.)","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 193","secondaryText":"وَقَٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ لِلَّهِ ۖ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/55?startingVerse=48","body":"With spreading branches;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Rahmaan","reference":"Ayah 48","secondaryText":"ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=60","body":"And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities, etc., have been accepted or not), because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 60","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=157","body":"They are those on whom are the Salawat (i.e. blessings, etc.) (i.e. who are blessed and will be forgiven) from their Lord, and (they are those who) receive His Mercy, and it is they who are the guided-ones.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 157","secondaryText":"أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَٰتٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌۭ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُهْتَدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/14?startingVerse=21","body":"And they all shall appear before Allah (on the Day of Resurrection) then the weak will say to those who were arrogant (chiefs): \"Verily, we were following you; can you avail us anything from Allah's Torment?\" They will say: \"Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. It makes no difference to us (now) whether we rage, or bear (these torments) with patience, there is no place of refuge for us.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ibrahim","reference":"Ayah 21","secondaryText":"وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًۭا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/53?startingVerse=52","body":"And the people of Nuh (Noah) aforetime, verily, they were more unjust and more rebellious and transgressing [in disobeying Allah and His Messenger Nuh (Noah)].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Najm","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/8?startingVerse=7","body":"And (remember) when Allah promised you (Muslims) one of the two parties (of the enemy i.e. either the army or the caravan) that it should be yours, you wished that the one not armed (the caravan) should be yours, but Allah willed to justify the truth by His Words and to cut off the roots of the disbelievers (i.e. in the battle of Badr).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anfaal","reference":"Ayah 7","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=28","body":"He sets forth for you a parable from your ownselves, - Do you have partners among those whom your right hands possess (i.e. your slaves) to share as equals in the wealth We have bestowed on you? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/38?startingVerse=26","body":"O Dawud (David)! Verily! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/58?startingVerse=4","body":"And he who finds not (the money for freeing a slave) must fast two successive months before they both touch each other. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/64?startingVerse=9","body":"(And remember) the Day when He will gather you (all) on the Day of Gathering, that will be the Day of mutual loss and gain (i.e. loss for the disbelievers as they will enter the Hell-fire and gain for the believers as they will enter Paradise). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=43","body":"See you not that Allah drives the clouds gently, then joins them together, then makes them into a heap of layers, and you see the rain comes forth from between them. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=246","body":"Have you not thought about the group of the Children of Israel after (the time of) Musa (Moses)? When they said to a Prophet of theirs, \"Appoint for us a king and we will fight in Allah's Way.\" He said, \"Would you then refrain from fighting, if fighting was prescribed for you?\" They said, \"Why should we not fight in Allah's Way while we have been driven out of our homes and our children (families have been taken as captives)?\" But when fighting was ordered for them, they turned away, all except a few of them. And Allah is All-Aware of the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 246","secondaryText":"أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِنَبِىٍّۢ لَّهُمُ ٱبْعَثْ لَنَا مَلِكًۭا نُّقَٰتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ هَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ أَلَّا تُقَٰتِلُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نُقَٰتِلَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ أُخْرِجْنَا مِن دِيَٰرِنَا وَأَبْنَآئِنَا ۖ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوْا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=18","body":"And We placed between them and the towns which We had blessed, towns easy to be seen, and We made the stages (of journey) between them easy (saying): \"Travel in them safely both by night and day.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saba","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًۭى ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=18","body":"And no bearer of burdens shall bear another's burden, and if one heavily laden calls another to (bear) his load, nothing of it will be lifted even though he be near of kin. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/19?startingVerse=69","body":"Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Beneficent (Allah).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Maryam","reference":"Ayah 69","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/49?startingVerse=9","body":"And if two parties or groups among the believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them both, but if one of them rebels against the other, then fight you (all) against the one that which rebels till it complies with the Command of Allah; then if it complies, then make reconciliation between them justly, and be equitable. Verily! Allah loves those who are equitable.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hujuraat","reference":"Ayah 9","secondaryText":"وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=57","body":"And they say: \"If we follow the guidance with you, we would be snatched away from our land.\" Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary (Makkah), to which are brought fruits of all kinds, a provision from Ourselves, but most of them know not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 57","secondaryText":"وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِن نَّتَّبِعِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَآ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا يُجْبَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ رِّزْقًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=66","body":"And if only they had acted according to the Taurat (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), and what has (now) been sent down to them from their Lord (the Quran), they would surely have gotten provision from above them and from underneath their feet. There are from among them people who are on the right course (i.e. they act on the revelation and believe in Prophet Muhammad SAW like 'Abdullah bin Salam), but many of them do evil deeds.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 66","secondaryText":"وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَأَكَلُوا۟ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِم ۚ مِّنْهُمْ أُمَّةٌۭ مُّقْتَصِدَةٌۭ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَعْمَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=33","body":"A Day when you will turn your backs and flee having no protector from Allah, And whomsoever Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 33","secondaryText":"يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍۢ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=118","body":"And (He did forgive also) the three [who did not join the Tabuk expedition (whom the Prophet SAW)] left (i.e. he did not give his judgement in their case, and their case was suspended for Allah's Decision) till for them the earth, vast as it is, was straitened and their ownselves were straitened to them, and they perceived that there is no fleeing from Allah, and no refuge but with Him. Then, He accepted their repentance, that they might repent (unto Him). Verily, Allah is the One Who accepts repentance, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 118","secondaryText":"وَعَلَى ٱلثَّلَٰثَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَن لَّا مَلْجَأَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّآ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَتُوبُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=177","body":"It is not Al-Birr (piety, righteousness, and each and every act of obedience to Allah, etc.) that you turn your faces towards east and (or) west (in prayers); but Al-Birr is (the quality of) the one who believes in Allah, the Last Day, the Angels, the Book, the Prophets and gives his wealth, in spite of love for it, to the kinsfolk, to the orphans, and to Al-Masakin (the poor), and to the wayfarer, and to those who ask, and to set slaves free, performs As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), and gives the Zakat, and who fulfill their covenant when they make it, and who are As-Sabirin (the patient ones, etc.) in extreme poverty and ailment (disease) and at the time of fighting (during the battles). Such are the people of the truth and they are Al-Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 177","secondaryText":"۞ لَّيْسَ ٱلْبِرَّ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَءَاتَى ٱلْمَالَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ ذَوِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَٱلسَّآئِلِينَ وَفِى ٱلرِّقَابِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِهِمْ إِذَا عَٰهَدُوا۟ ۖ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ فِى ٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَحِينَ ٱلْبَأْسِ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=15","body":"And he entered the city at a time of unawareness of its people, and he found there two men fighting, - one of his party (his religion - from the Children of Israel), and the other of his foes. The man of his (own) party asked him for help against his foe, so Musa (Moses) struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: \"This is of Shaitan's (Satan) doing, verily, he is a plain misleading enemy.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"وَدَخَلَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ ۖ فَٱسْتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّضِلٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=68","body":"And when you (Muhammad SAW) see those who engage in a false conversation about Our Verses (of the Quran) by mocking at them, stay away from them till they turn to another topic. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=93","body":"And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell to abide therein, and the Wrath and the Curse of Allah are upon him, and a great punishment is prepared for him.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 93","secondaryText":"وَمَن يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًۭا مُّتَعَمِّدًۭا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ خَٰلِدًۭا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُۥ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُۥ عَذَابًا عَظِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=118","body":"O you who believe! Take not as (your) Bitanah (advisors, consultants, protectors, helpers, friends, etc.) those outside your religion (pagans, Jews, Christians, and hypocrites) since they will not fail to do their best to corrupt you. They desire to harm you severely. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, but what their breasts conceal is far worse. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=178","body":"O you who believe! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/57?startingVerse=27","body":"Then, We sent after them, Our Messengers, and We sent 'Iesa (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), and gave him the Injeel (Gospel). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=43","body":"And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, they say: \"This (Muhammad SAW) is naught but a man who wishes to hinder you from that which your fathers used to worship.\" And they say: \"This is nothing but an invented lie.\" And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them (i.e. Prophet Muhammad SAW when Allah sent him as a Messenger with proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, etc.): \"This is nothing but evident magic!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saba","reference":"Ayah 43","secondaryText":"وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/42?startingVerse=16","body":"And those who dispute concerning Allah (His Religion of Islamic Monotheism, with which Muhammad SAW has been sent), after it has been accepted (by the people), of no use is their dispute before their Lord, and on them is wrath, and for them will be a severe torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shura","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌۭ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/77?startingVerse=43","body":"\"Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Mursalaat","reference":"Ayah 43","secondaryText":"كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=42","body":"So Today (i.e. the Day of Resurrection), none of you can profit or harm one another. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=20","body":"Musa (Moses) said: \"I did it then, when I was an ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 20","secondaryText":"قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=156","body":"And ordain for us good in this world, and in the Hereafter. That (Mercy) I shall ordain for those who are the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2), and give Zakat; and those who believe in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs and revelations, etc.);","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 156","secondaryText":"۞ وَٱكْتُبْ لَنَا فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ عَذَابِىٓ أُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَنْ أَشَآءُ ۖ وَرَحْمَتِى وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ ۚ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/43?startingVerse=63","body":"And when 'Iesa (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: \"I have come to you with Al-Hikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) in which you differ, therefore fear Allah and obey me,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zukhruf","reference":"Ayah 63","secondaryText":"وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=114","body":"And who is more unjust than those who forbid that Allah's Name be glorified and mentioned much (i.e. prayers and invocations, etc.) in Allah's Mosques and strive for their ruin? data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=78","body":"\"Wheresoever you may be, death will overtake you even if you are in fortresses built up strong and high!\" And if some good reaches them, they say, \"This is from Allah,\" but if some evil befalls them, they say, \"This is from you (O Muhammad SAW).\" Say: \"All things are from Allah,\" so what is wrong with these people that they fail to understand any word?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 78","secondaryText":"أَيْنَمَا تَكُونُوا۟ يُدْرِككُّمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُرُوجٍۢ مُّشَيَّدَةٍۢ ۗ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ حَسَنَةٌۭ يَقُولُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۭ يَقُولُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنْ عِندِكَ ۚ قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَمَالِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلْقَوْمِ لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ حَدِيثًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=61","body":"And (remember) when you said, \"O Musa (Moses)! We cannot endure one kind of food. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=23","body":"Forbidden to you (for marriage) are: your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, your father's sisters, your mother's sisters, your brother's daughters, your sister's daughters, your foster mother who gave you suck, your foster milk suckling sisters, your wives' mothers, your step daughters under your guardianship, born of your wives to whom you have gone in - but there is no sin on you if you have not gone in them (to marry their daughters), - the wives of your sons who (spring) from your own loins, and two sisters in wedlock at the same time, except for what has already passed; verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَّهَٰتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُكُمْ وَأَخَوَٰتُكُمْ وَعَمَّٰتُكُمْ وَخَٰلَٰتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُ ٱلْأَخِ وَبَنَاتُ ٱلْأُخْتِ وَأُمَّهَٰتُكُمُ ٱلَّٰتِىٓ أَرْضَعْنَكُمْ وَأَخَوَٰتُكُم مِّنَ ٱلرَّضَٰعَةِ وَأُمَّهَٰتُ نِسَآئِكُمْ وَرَبَٰٓئِبُكُمُ ٱلَّٰتِى فِى حُجُورِكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِكُمُ ٱلَّٰتِى دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَإِن لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَحَلَٰٓئِلُ أَبْنَآئِكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنْ أَصْلَٰبِكُمْ وَأَن تَجْمَعُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُخْتَيْنِ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=43","body":"O you who believe! Approach not As-Salat (the prayer) when you are in a drunken state until you know (the meaning) of what you utter, nor when you are in a state of Janaba, (i.e. in a state of sexual impurity and have not yet taken a bath) except when travelling on the road (without enough water, or just passing through a mosque), till you wash your whole body. And if you are ill, or on a journey, or one of you comes after answering the call of nature, or you have been in contact with women (by sexual relations) and you find no water, perform Tayammum with clean earth and rub therewith your faces and hands (Tayammum). Truly, Allah is Ever Oft-Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 43","secondaryText":"يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنتُمْ سُكَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعْلَمُوا۟ مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِى سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغْتَسِلُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَآءَ أَحَدٌۭ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلْغَآئِطِ أَوْ لَٰمَسْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ مَآءًۭ فَتَيَمَّمُوا۟ صَعِيدًۭا طَيِّبًۭا فَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=143","body":"Thus We have made you [true Muslims - real believers of Islamic Monotheism, true followers of Prophet Muhammad SAW and his Sunnah (legal ways)], a Wasat (just) (and the best) nation, that you be witnesses over mankind and the Messenger (Muhammad SAW) be a witness over you. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=60","body":"Have you seen those (hyprocrites) who claim that they believe in that which has been sent down to you, and that which was sent down before you, and they wish to go for judgement (in their disputes) to the Taghut (false judges, etc.) while they have been ordered to reject them. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/13?startingVerse=31","body":"And if there had been a Quran with which mountains could be moved (from their places), or the earth could be cloven asunder, or the dead could be made to speak (it would not have been other than this Quran). And a disaster will not cease to strike those who disbelieve because of their (evil) deeds or it (i.e. the disaster) settle close to their homes, until the Promise of Allah comes to pass. Certainly, Allah does not fail in His Promise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Ra'd","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْءَانًۭا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا۟ قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًۭا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ وَعْدُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=99","body":"And indeed We have sent down to you manifest Ayat (these Verses of the Quran which inform in detail about the news of the Jews and their secret intentions, etc.), and none disbelieve in them but Fasiqun (those who rebel against Allah's Command).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 99","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۖ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=53","body":"Thus We have tried some of them with others, that they might say: \"Is it these (poor believers) that Allah has favoured from amongst us?\" Does not Allah know best those who are grateful?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 53","secondaryText":"وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍۢ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/57?startingVerse=21","body":"Race one with another in hastening towards Forgiveness from your Lord (Allah), and towards Paradise, the width whereof is as the width of heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=173","body":"Or lest you should say: \"It was only our fathers afortime who took others as partners in worship along with Allah, and we were (merely their) descendants after them; will You then destroy us because of the deeds of men who practised Al-Batil (i.e. polytheism and committing crimes and sins, invoking and worshipping others besides Allah)?\" (Tafsir At-Tabari).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 173","secondaryText":"أَوْ تَقُولُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَشْرَكَ ءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةًۭ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ أَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=39","body":"If only those who disbelieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs; and they will not be helped.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 39","secondaryText":"لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ"}
