data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=37","body":"And this Quran is not such as could ever be produced by other than Allah (Lord of the heavens and the earth), but it is a confirmation of (the revelation) which was before it [i.e. the Taurat (Torah), and the Injeel (Gospel), etc.], and a full explanation of the Book (i.e. laws and orders, etc, decreed for mankind) - wherein there is no doubt from the the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns, and all that exists).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 37","secondaryText":"وَمَا كَانَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=104","body":"Verily, proofs have come to you from your Lord, so whosoever sees, will do so for (the good of) his ownself, and whosoever blinds himself, will do so to his own harm, and I (Muhammad SAW) am not a watcher over you.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 104","secondaryText":"قَدْ جَآءَكُم بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِىَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=18","body":"And they worship besides Allah things that hurt them not, nor profit them, and they say: \"These are our intercessors with Allah.\" Say: \"Do you inform Allah of that which He knows not in the heavens and on the earth?\" Glorified and Exalted be He above all that which they associate as partners with Him!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُفَعَٰٓؤُنَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّـُٔونَ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/59?startingVerse=7","body":"What Allah gave as booty (Fai') to His Messenger (Muhammad SAW) from the people of the townships, - it is for Allah, His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), the kindred (of Messenger Muhammad SAW), the orphans, Al-Masakin (the poor), and the wayfarer, in order that it may not become a fortune used by the rich among you. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=69","body":"Surely, those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah, in His Messenger Muhammad SAW and all that was revealed to him from Allah), those who are the Jews and the Sabians and the Christians, - whosoever believed in Allah and the Last Day, and worked righteousness, on them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 69","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـُٔونَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=84","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"We believe in Allah and in what has been sent down to us, and what was sent down to Ibrahim (Abraham), Isma'il (Ishmael), Ishaque (Isaac), Ya'qub (Jacob) and Al-Asbat [the twelve sons of Ya'qub (Jacob)] and what was given to Musa (Moses), 'Iesa (Jesus) and the Prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between one another among them and to Him (Allah) we have submitted (in Islam).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 84","secondaryText":"قُلْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=197","body":"The Hajj (pilgrimage) is (in) the well-known (lunar year) months (i.e. the 10th month, the 11th month and the first ten days of the 12th month of the Islamic calendar, i.e. two months and ten days). So whosoever intends to perform Hajj therein by assuming Ihram), then he should not have sexual relations (with his wife), nor commit sin, nor dispute unjustly during the Hajj. And whatever good you do, (be sure) Allah knows it. And take a provision (with you) for the journey, but the best provision is At-Taqwa (piety, righteousness, etc.). So fear Me, O men of understanding!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 197","secondaryText":"ٱلْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌۭ مَّعْلُومَٰتٌۭ ۚ فَمَن فَرَضَ فِيهِنَّ ٱلْحَجَّ فَلَا رَفَثَ وَلَا فُسُوقَ وَلَا جِدَالَ فِى ٱلْحَجِّ ۗ وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَتَزَوَّدُوا۟ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ ٱلزَّادِ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ وَٱتَّقُونِ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/42?startingVerse=45","body":"And you will see them brought forward to it (Hell) made humble by disgrace, (and) looking with stealthy glance. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/8?startingVerse=29","body":"O you who believe! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=34","body":"The good deed and the evil deed cannot be equal. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=25","body":"Al-La (this word has two interpretations) (A) [As Shaitan (Satan) has barred them from Allah's Way] so that they do not worship (prostrate before) Allah, or (B) So that they may worship (prostrate before) Allah, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=54","body":"Your Lord knows you best, if He will, He will have mercy on you, or if He will, He will punish you. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/32?startingVerse=27","body":"Have they not seen how We drive water (rain clouds) to the dry land without any vegetation, and therewith bring forth crops providing food for their cattle and themselves? Will they not then see?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Sajda","reference":"Ayah 27","secondaryText":"أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/87?startingVerse=4","body":"And Who brings out the pasturage,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'laa","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/99?startingVerse=8","body":"And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zalzala","reference":"Ayah 8","secondaryText":"وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=95","body":"Then We changed the evil for the good, until they increased in number and in wealth, and said: \"Our fathers were touched with evil (loss of health and calamities) and with good (prosperity, etc.).\" So We seized them of a sudden while they were unaware.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 95","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ ٱلسَّيِّئَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّىٰ عَفَوا۟ وَّقَالُوا۟ قَدْ مَسَّ ءَابَآءَنَا ٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَٱلسَّرَّآءُ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=90","body":"The chiefs of those who disbelieved among his people said (to their people): \"If you follow Shu'aib, be sure then you will be the losers!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 90","secondaryText":"وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=37","body":"It is neither their meat nor their blood that reaches Allah, but it is piety from you that reaches Him. Thus have We made them subject to you that you may magnify Allah for His Guidance to you. And give glad tidings (O Muhammad SAW) to the Muhsinun (doers of good).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 37","secondaryText":"لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/81?startingVerse=15","body":"So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Takwir","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=186","body":"And when My slaves ask you (O Muhammad SAW) concerning Me, then (answer them), I am indeed near (to them by My Knowledge). I respond to the invocations of the supplicant when he calls on Me (without any mediator or intercessor). So let them obey Me and believe in Me, so that they may be led aright.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 186","secondaryText":"وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=54","body":"They ask you to hasten on the torment. And verily! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=133","body":"If He wills, He can take you away, O people, and bring others. And Allah is Ever All-Potent over that.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 133","secondaryText":"إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَيَأْتِ بِـَٔاخَرِينَ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ قَدِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=35","body":"But none is granted it (the above quality) except those who are patient, and none is granted it except the owner of the great portion (of the happiness in the Hereafter i.e. Paradise and in this world of a high moral character).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Fussilat","reference":"Ayah 35","secondaryText":"وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=167","body":"And (remember) when your Lord declared that He would certainly keep on sending against them (i.e. the Jews), till the Day of Resurrection, those who would afflict them with a humiliating torment. Verily, your Lord is Quick in Retribution (for the disobedient, wicked) and certainly He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (for the obedient and those who beg Allah's Forgiveness).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 167","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَن يَسُومُهُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/36?startingVerse=73","body":"And they have (other) benefits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink, will they not then be grateful?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yaseen","reference":"Ayah 73","secondaryText":"وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=65","body":"And Allah sends down water (rain) from the sky, then He revives the earth therewith after its death. Verily, in this is a sign (clear proof) for people who listen (obey Allah).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 65","secondaryText":"وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=35","body":"And indeed We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurat (Torah)], and placed his brother Harun (Aaron) with him as a helper;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Furqaan","reference":"Ayah 35","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=99","body":"They were pursued by a curse in this (deceiving life of this world) and (so they will be pursued by a curse) on the Day of Resurrection. How bad is the curse (in this world) pursued by another curse (in the Hereafter).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 99","secondaryText":"وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةًۭ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=100","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Not equal are Al-Khabith (all that is evil and bad as regards things, deeds, beliefs, persons, foods, etc.) and At-Taiyib (all that is good as regards things, deeds, beliefs, persons, foods, etc.), even though the abundance of Al-Khabith (evil) may please you.\" So fear Allah much [(abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden) and love Allah much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)], O men of understanding in order that you may be successful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 100","secondaryText":"قُل لَّا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْخَبِيثُ وَٱلطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ ٱلْخَبِيثِ ۚ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=30","body":"Verily, you (O Muhammad SAW) will die and verily, they (too) will die.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 30","secondaryText":"إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌۭ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=32","body":"Then We gave the Book the Quran) for inheritance to such of Our slaves whom We chose (the followers of Muhammad SAW). Then of them are some who wrong their ownselves, and of them are some who follow a middle course, and of them are some who are, by Allah's Leave, foremost in good deeds. That (inheritance of the Quran), that is indeed a great grace.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 32","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=3","body":"Those who perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and give Zakat and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naml","reference":"Ayah 3","secondaryText":"ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/71?startingVerse=20","body":"That you may go about therein in broad roads.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Nooh","reference":"Ayah 20","secondaryText":"لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=50","body":"So those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, for them is forgiveness and Rizqun Karim (generous provision, i.e. Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 50","secondaryText":"فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=3","body":"And among mankind is he who disputes concerning Allah, without knowledge, and follows every rebellious (disobedient to Allah) Shaitan (devil) (devoid of each and every kind of good).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 3","secondaryText":"وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّرِيدٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/36?startingVerse=49","body":"They await only but a single Saihah (shout, etc.), which will seize them while they are disputing!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yaseen","reference":"Ayah 49","secondaryText":"مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/43?startingVerse=67","body":"Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except Al-Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zukhruf","reference":"Ayah 67","secondaryText":"ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=70","body":"Has not the story reached them of those before them? - The people of Nuh (Noah), 'Ad, and Thamud, the people of Ibrahim (Abraham), the dwellers of Madyan (Midian) and the cities overthrown [i.e. the people to whom Lout (Lot) preached], to them came their Messengers with clear proofs. So it was not Allah Who wronged them, but they used to wrong themselves.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 70","secondaryText":"أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ وَقَوْمِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَأَصْحَٰبِ مَدْيَنَ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتِ ۚ أَتَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=66","body":"[Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: \"Do you then worship besides Allah, things that can neither profit you, nor harm you?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 66","secondaryText":"قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=9","body":"Do they not travel in the land, and see what was the end of those before them? They were superior to them in strength, and they tilled the earth and populated it in greater numbers than these (pagans) have done, and there came to them their Messengers with clear proofs. Surely, Allah wronged them not, but they used to wrong themselves.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Room","reference":"Ayah 9","secondaryText":"أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=150","body":"And from wheresoever you start forth (for prayers), turn your face in the direction of Al-Masjid-al-Haram (at Makkah), and wheresoever you are, turn your faces towards, it (when you pray) so that men may have no argument against you except those of them that are wrong-doers, so fear them not, but fear Me! - And so that I may complete My Blessings on you and that you may be guided.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 150","secondaryText":"وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۚ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنتُمْ فَوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُۥ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيْكُمْ حُجَّةٌ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِى وَلِأُتِمَّ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=17","body":"Can they (Muslims) who rely on a clear proof (the Quran) from their Lord, and whom a witness [Prophet Muhammad SAW through Jibrael (Gabriel)] from Him follows it (can they be equal with the disbelievers); and before it, came the Book of Musa (Moses), a guidance and a mercy, they believe therein, but those of the sects (Jews, Christians and all the other non-Muslim nations) that reject it (the Quran), the Fire will be their promised meeting-place. So be not in doubt about it (i.e. those who denied Prophet Muhammad SAW and also denied all that which he brought from Allah, surely, they will enter Hell). Verily, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the mankind believe not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/8?startingVerse=47","body":"And be not like those who come out of their homes boastfully and to be seen of men, and hinder (men) from the Path of Allah. and Allah is Muhitun (encircling and thoroughly comprehending) all that they do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anfaal","reference":"Ayah 47","secondaryText":"وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بَطَرًۭا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=87","body":"\"And if there is a party of you who believes in that with which I have been sent and a party who do not believe, so be patient until Allah judges between us, and He is the Best of judges.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 87","secondaryText":"وَإِن كَانَ طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنكُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَٱصْبِرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا ۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/48?startingVerse=25","body":"They are the ones who disbelieved (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism), and hindered you from Al-Masjid-al-Haram (the sacred mosque of Makkah) and the sacrificial animals, detained from reaching their place of sacrifice. Had there not been believing men and believing women whom you did not know, that you may kill them, and on whose account a sin would have been committed by you without (your) knowledge, that Allah might bring into His Mercy whom He will, if they (the believers and the disbelievers) should have been apart, We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved, with painful torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Fath","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/67?startingVerse=18","body":"And indeed those before them belied (the Messengers of Allah), then how terrible was My denial (punishment)?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Mulk","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/51?startingVerse=52","body":"Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them, but they said: \"A sorcerer or a madman!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Adh-Dhaariyat","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=61","body":"Then whoever disputes with you concerning him ['Iesa (Jesus)] after (all this) knowledge that has come to you, [i.e. 'Iesa (Jesus)] being a slave of Allah, and having no share in Divinity) say: (O Muhammad SAW) \"Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves - then we pray and invoke (sincerely) the Curse of Allah upon those who lie.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 61","secondaryText":"فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=25","body":"And of them there are some who listen to you; but We have set veils on their hearts, so they understand it not, and deafness in their ears; if they see every one of the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) they will not believe therein; to the point that when they come to you to argue with you, the disbelievers say: \"These are nothing but tales of the men of old.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۚ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/71?startingVerse=9","body":"\"Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private,","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Nooh","reference":"Ayah 9","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=78","body":"And (remember) Dawud (David) and Sulaiman (Solomon), when they gave judgement in the case of the field in which the sheep of certain people had pastured at night and We were witness to their judgement.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 78","secondaryText":"وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=67","body":"The hypocrites, men and women, are from one another, they enjoin (on the people) Al-Munkar (i.e. disbelief and polytheism of all kinds and all that Islam has forbidden), and forbid (people) from Al-Ma'ruf (i.e. Islamic Monotheism and all that Islam orders one to do), and they close their hands [from giving (spending in Allah's Cause) alms, etc.]. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=124","body":"And when there comes to them a sign (from Allah) they say: \"We shall not believe until we receive the like of that which the Messengers of Allah had received.\" Allah knows best with whom to place His Message. Humiliation and disgrace from Allah and a severe torment will overtake the criminals (polytheists, sinners, etc.) for that which they used to plot.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 124","secondaryText":"وَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌۭ قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤْتَىٰ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِ ۘ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥ ۗ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَمْكُرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=11","body":"And when it is said to them: \"Make not mischief on the earth,\" they say: \"We are only peacemakers.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=3","body":"But only as a Reminder to those who fear (Allah).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 3","secondaryText":"إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=10","body":"Of mankind are some who say: \"We believe in Allah,\" but if they are made to suffer for the sake of Allah, they consider the trial of mankind as Allah's punishment, and if victory comes from your Lord, (the hypocrites) will say: \"Verily! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=17","body":"Then I will come to them from before them and behind them, from their right and from their left, and You will not find most of them as thankful ones (i.e. they will not be dutiful to You).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمْ ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَٰكِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=65","body":"And when they embark on a ship, they invoke Allah, making their Faith pure for Him only, but when He brings them safely to land, behold, they give a share of their worship to others.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 65","secondaryText":"فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/46?startingVerse=14","body":"Such shall be the dwellers of Paradise, abiding therein (forever), a reward for what they used to do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahqaf","reference":"Ayah 14","secondaryText":"أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/31?startingVerse=20","body":"See you not (O men) that Allah has subjected for you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and has completed and perfected His Graces upon you, (both) apparent (i.e. Islamic Monotheism, and the lawful pleasures of this world, including health, good looks, etc.) and hidden [i.e. One's Faith in Allah (of Islamic Monotheism) knowledge, wisdom, guidance for doing righteous deeds, and also the pleasures and delights of the Hereafter in Paradise, etc.]? data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=46","body":"And if they had intended to march out, certainly, they would have made some preparation for it, but Allah was averse to their being sent forth, so He made them lag behind, and it was said (to them), \"Sit you among those who sit (at home).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 46","secondaryText":"۞ وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا۟ ٱلْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا۟ لَهُۥ عُدَّةًۭ وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ ٱللَّهُ ٱنۢبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ ٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/14?startingVerse=10","body":"Their Messengers said: \"What! Can there be a doubt about Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? data: {"url":"https://quran.com/53?startingVerse=32","body":"Those who avoid great sins (see the Quran, Verses: 6:152, 153) and Al-Fawahish (illegal sexual intercourse, etc.) except the small faults, verily, your Lord is of vast forgiveness. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=33","body":"The recompense of those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger and do mischief in the land is only that they shall be killed or crucified or their hands and their feet be cut off on the opposite sides, or be exiled from the land. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=146","body":"I shall turn away from My Ayat (verses of the Quran) those who behave arrogantly on the earth, without a right, and (even) if they see all the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they will not believe in them. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=24","body":"This is because they say: \"The Fire shall not touch us but for a number of days.\" And that which they used to invent regarding their religion has deceived them.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 24","secondaryText":"ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=228","body":"And divorced women shall wait (as regards their marriage) for three menstrual periods, and it is not lawful for them to conceal what Allah has created in their wombs, if they believe in Allah and the Last Day. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=31","body":"And tell the believing women to lower their gaze (from looking at forbidden things), and protect their private parts (from illegal sexual acts, etc.) and not to show off their adornment except only that which is apparent (like palms of hands or one eye or both eyes for necessity to see the way, or outer dress like veil, gloves, head-cover, apron, etc.), and to draw their veils all over Juyubihinna (i.e. their bodies, faces, necks and bosoms, etc.) and not to reveal their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husband's fathers, their sons, their husband's sons, their brothers or their brother's sons, or their sister's sons, or their (Muslim) women (i.e. their sisters in Islam), or the (female) slaves whom their right hands possess, or old male servants who lack vigour, or small children who have no sense of the shame of sex. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And all of you beg Allah to forgive you all, O believers, that you may be successful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Noor","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=2","body":"The woman and the man guilty of illegal sexual intercourse, flog each of them with a hundred stripes. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/59?startingVerse=9","body":"And those who, before them, had homes (in Al-Madinah) and had adopted the Faith, love those who emigrate to them, and have no jealousy in their breasts for that which they have been given (from the booty of Bani An-Nadir), and give them (emigrants) preference over themselves, even though they were in need of that. And whosoever is saved from his own covetousness, such are they who will be the successful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hashr","reference":"Ayah 9","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو ٱلدَّارَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةًۭ مِّمَّآ أُوتُوا۟ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌۭ ۚ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=76","body":"So when came to them the truth from Us, they said: \"This is indeed clear magic.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 76","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=58","body":"Or (lest) he should say when he sees the torment: \"If only I had another chance (to return to the world) then I should indeed be among the Muhsinun (good-doers - see V. 2:112).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 58","secondaryText":"أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةًۭ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=58","body":"And your Lord is Most Forgiving, Owner of Mercy. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=51","body":"And warn therewith (the Quran) those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord, when there will be neither a protector nor an intercessor for them besides Him, so that they may fear Allah and keep their duty to Him (by abstaining from committing sins and by doing all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 51","secondaryText":"وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۙ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّۭ وَلَا شَفِيعٌۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/75?startingVerse=18","body":"And when We have recited it to you [O Muhammad SAW through Jibrael (Gabriel)], then follow you its (the Quran's) recital.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qiyaama","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=32","body":"And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): \"Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=48","body":"And fear a Day (of Judgement) when a person shall not avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from him nor will compensation be taken from him nor will they be helped.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 48","secondaryText":"وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًۭا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَٰعَةٌۭ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/68?startingVerse=23","body":"So they departed, conversing in secret low tones (saying),","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qalam","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=27","body":"See you not that Allah sends down water (rain) from the sky, and We produce therewith fruits of varying colours, and among the mountains are streaks white and red, of varying colours and (others) very black.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 27","secondaryText":"أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌۭ وَحُمْرٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=53","body":"But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its belief.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 53","secondaryText":"فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=158","body":"And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinns, but the jinns know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be brought for accounts).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 158","secondaryText":"وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=178","body":"And let not the disbelievers think that Our postponing of their punishment is good for them. We postpone the punishment only so that they may increase in sinfulness. And for them is a disgracing torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 178","secondaryText":"وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا نُمْلِى لَهُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لِّأَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّمَا نُمْلِى لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِثْمًۭا ۚ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=92","body":"And to recite the Quran, so whosoever receives guidance, receives it for the good of his ownself, and whosoever goes astray, say (to him): \"I am only one of the warners.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naml","reference":"Ayah 92","secondaryText":"وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/19?startingVerse=58","body":"Those were they unto whom Allah bestowed His Grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Nuh (Noah), and of the offspring of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Israel and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the Verses of the Most Beneficent (Allah) were recited unto them, they fell down prostrating and weeping.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Maryam","reference":"Ayah 58","secondaryText":"أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=47","body":"And if (We had) not (sent you to the people of Makkah) in case a calamity should seize them for (the deeds) that their hands have sent forth, they should have said: \"Our Lord! Why did You not send us a Messenger? We should then have followed Your Ayat (Verses of the Quran) and should have been among the believers.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 47","secondaryText":"وَلَوْلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=222","body":"They ask you concerning menstruation. Say: that is an Adha (a harmful thing for a husband to have a sexual intercourse with his wife while she is having her menses), therefore keep away from women during menses and go not unto them till they have purified (from menses and have taken a bath). And when they have purified themselves, then go in unto them as Allah has ordained for you (go in unto them in any manner as long as it is in their vagina). Truly, Allah loves those who turn unto Him in repentance and loves those who purify themselves (by taking a bath and cleaning and washing thoroughly their private parts, bodies, for their prayers, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 222","secondaryText":"وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًۭى فَٱعْتَزِلُوا۟ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فِى ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=67","body":"He, it is Who has created you (Adam) from dust, then from a Nutfah [mixed semen drops of male and female discharge (i.e. Adam's offspring)] then from a clot (a piece of coagulated blood), then brings you forth as children, then (makes you grow) to reach the age of full strength, and afterwards to be old (men and women), though some among you die before, and that you reach an appointed term, in order that you may understand.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 67","secondaryText":"هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًۭا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًۭا مُّسَمًّۭى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=119","body":"Verily, I will mislead them, and surely, I will arouse in them false desires; and certainly, I will order them to slit the ears of cattle, and indeed I will order them to change the nature created by Allah.\" And whoever takes Shaitan (Satan) as a Wali (protector or helper) instead of Allah, has surely suffered a manifest loss.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 119","secondaryText":"وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمْ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمْ وَلَءَامُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ ءَاذَانَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ وَلَءَامُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلْقَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ وَلِيًّۭا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ خَسِرَ خُسْرَانًۭا مُّبِينًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=258","body":"Have you not looked at him who disputed with Ibrahim (Abraham) about his Lord (Allah), because Allah had given him the kingdom? When Ibrahim (Abraham) said (to him): \"My Lord (Allah) is He Who gives life and causes death.\" He said, \"I give life and cause death.\" Ibrahim (Abraham) said, \"Verily! Allah causes the sun to rise from the east; then cause it you to rise from the west.\" So the disbeliever was utterly defeated. And Allah guides not the people, who are Zalimun (wrong-doers, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 258","secondaryText":"أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِى حَآجَّ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ فِى رَبِّهِۦٓ أَنْ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ إِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّىَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ قَالَ أَنَا۠ أُحْىِۦ وَأُمِيتُ ۖ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْتِى بِٱلشَّمْسِ مِنَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ فَأْتِ بِهَا مِنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ فَبُهِتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=282","body":"O you who believe! When you contract a debt for a fixed period, write it down. Let a scribe write it down in justice between you. Let not the scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him, so let him write. Let him (the debtor) who incurs the liability dictate, and he must fear Allah, his Lord, and diminish not anything of what he owes. But if the debtor is of poor understanding, or weak, or is unable himself to dictate, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And get two witnesses out of your own men. And if there are not two men (available), then a man and two women, such as you agree for witnesses, so that if one of them (two women) errs, the other can remind her. And the witnesses should not refuse when they are called on (for evidence). You should not become weary to write it (your contract), whether it be small or big, for its fixed term, that is more just with Allah; more solid as evidence, and more convenient to prevent doubts among yourselves, save when it is a present trade which you carry out on the spot among yourselves, then there is no sin on you if you do not write it down. But take witnesses whenever you make a commercial contract. Let neither scribe nor witness suffer any harm, but if you do (such harm), it would be wickedness in you. So be afraid of Allah; and Allah teaches you. And Allah is the All-Knower of each and everything.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 282","secondaryText":"يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌۭ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةًۭ تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌۭ وَلَا شَهِيدٌۭ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/73?startingVerse=20","body":"Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so do a party of those with you, And Allah measures the night and the day. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=64","body":"\"And Istafziz [literally means: befool them gradually] those whom you can among them with your voice (i.e. songs, music, and any other call for Allah's disobedience), make assaults on them with your cavalry and your infantry, mutually share with them wealth and children (by tempting them to earn money by illegal ways usury, etc., or by committing illegal sexual intercourse, etc.), and make promises to them.\" But Satan promises them nothing but deceit.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Israa","reference":"Ayah 64","secondaryText":"وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ ۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=259","body":"Or like the one who passed by a town and it had tumbled over its roofs. He said: \"Oh! How will Allah ever bring it to life after its death?\" So Allah caused him to die for a hundred years, then raised him up (again). He said: \"How long did you remain (dead)?\" He (the man) said: \"(Perhaps) I remained (dead) a day or part of a day\". He said: \"Nay, you have remained (dead) for a hundred years, look at your food and your drink, they show no change; and look at your donkey! And thus We have made of you a sign for the people. Look at the bones, how We bring them together and clothe them with flesh\". When this was clearly shown to him, he said, \"I know (now) that Allah is Able to do all things.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 259","secondaryText":"أَوْ كَٱلَّذِى مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍۢ وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا قَالَ أَنَّىٰ يُحْىِۦ هَٰذِهِ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۖ فَأَمَاتَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِا۟ئَةَ عَامٍۢ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ ۖ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۖ قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِا۟ئَةَ عَامٍۢ فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِكَ وَشَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰ حِمَارِكَ وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًۭا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥ قَالَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=3","body":"And a declaration from Allah and His Messenger to mankind on the greatest day (the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah - the 12th month of Islamic calendar) that Allah is free from (all) obligations to the Mushrikun (see V. 2:105) and so is His Messenger. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/58?startingVerse=11","body":"O you who believe! When you are told to make room in the assemblies, (spread out and) make room. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=38","body":"\"But as for my part (I believe) that He is Allah, my Lord and none shall I associate as partner with my Lord.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 38","secondaryText":"لَّٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/31?startingVerse=30","body":"That is because Allah, He is the Truth, and that which they invoke besides Him is Al-Batil (falsehood, Satan and all other false deities), and that Allah, He is the Most High, the Most Great.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Luqman","reference":"Ayah 30","secondaryText":"ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=83","body":"Then when their Messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were glad (and proud) with that which they had of the knowledge (of worldly things): And that at which they used to mock, surrounded them (i.e. the punishment).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 83","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/32?startingVerse=5","body":"He arranges (every) affair from the heavens to the earth, then it (affair) will go up to Him, in one Day, the space whereof is a thousand years of your reckoning (i.e. reckoning of our present world's time).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Sajda","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=34","body":"And every nation has its appointed term; when their term is reached, neither can they delay it nor can they advance it an hour (or a moment).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 34","secondaryText":"وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌۭ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=24","body":"That Allah may reward the men of truth for their truth (i.e. for their patience at the accomplishment of that which they covenanted with Allah), and punish the hypocrites if He will or accept their repentance by turning to them in Mercy. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=52","body":"And (remember) the Day He will say:\"Call those (so-called) partners of Mine whom you pretended.\" Then they will cry unto them, but they will not answer them, and We shall put Maubiqa (a barrier, or enmity, or destruction, or a valley in Hell) between them.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/71?startingVerse=13","body":"What is the matter with you, [that you fear not Allah (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allah or you believe not in His Oneness).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Nooh","reference":"Ayah 13","secondaryText":"مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=40","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Tell me or inform me (what) do you think about your (socalled) partnergods to whom you call upon besides Allah, show me, what they have created of the earth? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=52","body":"So verily, you (O Muhammad SAW) cannot make the dead to hear (i.e. the disbelievers, etc.), nor can you make the deaf to hear the call, when they show their backs, turning away.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Room","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/90?startingVerse=17","body":"Then he became one of those who believed, and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Balad","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=76","body":"'Adn (Edn) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), under which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever: such is the reward of those who purify themselves [(by abstaining from all kinds of sins and evil deeds) which Allah has forbidden and by doing all that which Allah has ordained)].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 76","secondaryText":"جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=9","body":"Then We fulfilled to them the promise, and We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifun (i.e. extravagants in oppression, polytheism and in sin).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 9","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=42","body":"And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection, they will be among Al-Maqbuhun (those who are prevented to receive Allah's Mercy or any good, despised or destroyed, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 42","secondaryText":"وَأَتْبَعْنَٰهُمْ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةًۭ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَقْبُوحِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=15","body":"Then as for those who believed (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) and did righteous good deeds, such shall be honoured and made to enjoy luxurious life (forever) in a Garden of delight (Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Room","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍۢ يُحْبَرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=50","body":"Say: \"Tell me, - if His torment should come to you by night or by day, - which portion thereof would the Mujrimun (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals) hasten on?\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 50","secondaryText":"قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَٰتًا أَوْ نَهَارًۭا مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/57?startingVerse=20","body":"Know that the life of this world is only play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children, as the likeness of vegetation after rain, thereof the growth is pleasing to the tiller; afterwards it dries up and you see it turning yellow; then it becomes straw. But in the Hereafter (there is) a severe torment (for the disbelievers, evil-doers), and (there is) Forgiveness from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure (for the believers, good-doers), whereas the life of this world is only a deceiving enjoyment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hadid","reference":"Ayah 20","secondaryText":"ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ وَزِينَةٌۭ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًۭا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=37","body":"And they said: \"Why is not a sign sent down to him from his Lord?\" Say: \"Allah is certainly Able to send down a sign, but most of them know not.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 37","secondaryText":"وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةًۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=63","body":"Then We inspired Musa (Moses) (saying): \"Strike the sea with your stick.\" And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 63","secondaryText":"فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ"}

title: The Quran

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=11","body":"Allah commands you as regards your children's (inheritance); to the male, a portion equal to that of two females; if (there are) only daughters, two or more, their share is two thirds of the inheritance; if only one, her share is half. For parents, a sixth share of inheritance to each if the deceased left children; if no children, and the parents are the (only) heirs, the mother has a third; if the deceased left brothers or (sisters), the mother has a sixth. (The distribution in all cases is) after the payment of legacies he may have bequeathed or debts. You know not which of them, whether your parents or your children, are nearest to you in benefit, (these fixed shares) are ordained by Allah. And Allah is Ever All-Knower, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"يُوصِيكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِىٓ أَوْلَٰدِكُمْ ۖ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ ۚ فَإِن كُنَّ نِسَآءًۭ فَوْقَ ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُنَّ ثُلُثَا مَا تَرَكَ ۖ وَإِن كَانَتْ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَلَهَا ٱلنِّصْفُ ۚ وَلِأَبَوَيْهِ لِكُلِّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا ٱلسُّدُسُ مِمَّا تَرَكَ إِن كَانَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌۭ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلَدٌۭ وَوَرِثَهُۥٓ أَبَوَاهُ فَلِأُمِّهِ ٱلثُّلُثُ ۚ فَإِن كَانَ لَهُۥٓ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَلِأُمِّهِ ٱلسُّدُسُ ۚ مِنۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍۢ يُوصِى بِهَآ أَوْ دَيْنٍ ۗ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَأَبْنَآؤُكُمْ لَا تَدْرُونَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ لَكُمْ نَفْعًۭا ۚ فَرِيضَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=59","body":"And with Him are the keys of the Ghaib (all that is hidden), none knows them but He. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=99","body":"And of the bedouins there are some who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and look upon what they spend in Allah's Cause as approaches to Allah, and a cause of receiving the Messenger's invocations. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=36","body":"Then when Musa (Moses) came to them with Our Clear Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they said: \"This is nothing but invented magic. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=41","body":"The likeness of those who take Auliya' (protectors and helpers) other than Allah is as the likeness of a spider, who builds (for itself) a house, but verily, the frailest (weakest) of houses is the spider's house; if they but knew.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 41","secondaryText":"مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًۭا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=67","body":"And (remember) when Musa (Moses) said to his people: \"Verily, Allah commands you that you slaughter a cow.\" They said, \"Do you make fun of us?\" He said, \"I take Allah's Refuge from being among Al-Jahilun (the ignorants or the foolish).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 67","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا۟ بَقَرَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=96","body":"And if the people of the towns had believed and had the Taqwa (piety), certainly, We should have opened for them blessings from the heaven and the earth, but they belied (the Messengers). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/60?startingVerse=4","body":"Indeed there has been an excellent example for you in Ibrahim (Abraham) and those with him, when they said to their people: \"Verily, we are free from you and whatever you worship besides Allah, we have rejected you, and there has started between us and you, hostility and hatred for ever, until you believe in Allah Alone,\" except the saying of Ibrahim (Abraham) to his father: \"Verily, I will ask for forgiveness (from Allah) for you, but I have no power to do anything for you before Allah.\" Our Lord! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/8?startingVerse=73","body":"And those who disbelieve are allies to one another, (and) if you (Muslims of the whole world collectively) do not do so (i.e. become allies, as one united block with one Khalifah - chief Muslim ruler for the whole Muslim world to make victorious Allah's Religion of Islamic Monotheism), there will be Fitnah (wars, battles, polytheism, etc.) and oppression on earth, and a great mischief and corruption (appearance of polytheism).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anfaal","reference":"Ayah 73","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=39","body":"But whosoever repents after his crime and does righteous good deeds (by obeying Allah), then verily, Allah will pardon him (accept his repentance). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=133","body":"Or were you witnesses when death approached Ya'qub (Jacob)? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=22","body":"On the Day they will see the angels, no glad tidings will there be for the Mujrimun (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, etc.) that day. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=65","body":"And if only the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) had believed (in Muhammad SAW) and warded off evil (sin, ascribing partners to Allah) and had become Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V. 2:2) We would indeed have blotted out their sins and admitted them to Gardens of pleasure (in Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 65","secondaryText":"وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=135","body":"O you who believe! Stand out firmly for justice, as witnesses to Allah, even though it be against yourselves, or your parents, or your kin, be he rich or poor, Allah is a Better Protector to both (than you). So follow not the lusts (of your hearts), lest you may avoid justice, and if you distort your witness or refuse to give it, verily, Allah is Ever Well-Acquainted with what you do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 135","secondaryText":"۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ ۚ إِن يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًۭا فَٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِمَا ۖ فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن تَلْوُۥٓا۟ أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=62","body":"Is not He (better than your gods) Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=105","body":"Surely, We have sent down to you (O Muhammad SAW) the Book (this Quran) in truth that you might judge between men by that which Allah has shown you (i.e. has taught you through Divine Inspiration), so be not a pleader for the treacherous.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 105","secondaryText":"إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِمَآ أَرَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَا تَكُن لِّلْخَآئِنِينَ خَصِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=143","body":"And when Musa (Moses) came at the time and place appointed by Us, and his Lord spoke to him, he said: \"O my Lord! Show me (Yourself), that I may look upon You.\" Allah said: \"You cannot see Me, but look upon the mountain if it stands still in its place then you shall see Me.\" So when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He made it collapse to dust, and Musa (Moses) fell down unconscious. Then when he recovered his senses he said: \"Glory be to You, I turn to You in repentance and I am the first of the believers.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 143","secondaryText":"وَلَمَّا جَآءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَٰتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِىٓ أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ لَن تَرَىٰنِى وَلَٰكِنِ ٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُۥ فَسَوْفَ تَرَىٰنِى ۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُۥ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُۥ دَكًّۭا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًۭا ۚ فَلَمَّآ أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=6","body":"Perhaps, you, would kill yourself (O Muhammad SAW) in grief, over their footsteps (for their turning away from you), because they believe not in this narration (the Quran).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=45","body":"Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=12","body":"(Allah) said: \"What prevented you (O Iblis) that you did not prostrate, when I commanded you?\" Iblis said: \"I am better than him (Adam), You created me from fire, and him You created from clay.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=133","body":"They say: \"Why does he not bring us a sign (proof) from his Lord?\" Has there not come to them the proof of that which is (written) in the former papers [Scriptures, i.e. the Taurat (Torah), and the Injeel (Gospel), etc. about the coming of the Prophet Muhammad SAW].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 133","secondaryText":"وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=4","body":"He has created man from Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=42","body":"So when she came, it was said (to her): \"Is your throne like this?\" She said: \"(It is) as though it were the very same.\" And [Sulaiman (Solomon) said]: \"Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we were submitted to Allah (in Islam as Muslims before her).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naml","reference":"Ayah 42","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/61?startingVerse=12","body":"(If you do so) He will forgive you your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow, and pleasant dwelling in Gardens of 'Adn - Eternity ['Adn (Edn) Paradise], that is indeed the great success.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saff","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةًۭ فِى جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=56","body":"Surely! Those who disbelieved in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) We shall burn them in Fire. As often as their skins are roasted through, We shall change them for other skins that they may taste the punishment. Truly, Allah is Ever Most Powerful, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 56","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا سَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِمْ نَارًۭا كُلَّمَا نَضِجَتْ جُلُودُهُم بَدَّلْنَٰهُمْ جُلُودًا غَيْرَهَا لِيَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=87","body":"And let them not turn you (O Muhammad SAW) away from (preaching) the Ayat (revelations and verses) of Allah after they have been sent down to you, and invite (men) to (believe in) your Lord [i.e. in the Oneness (Tauhid) of Allah (1) Oneness of the Lordship of Allah; (2) Oneness of the worship of Allah; (3) Oneness of the Names and Qualities of Allah], and be not of Al-Mushrikun (those who associate partners with Allah, e.g. polytheists, pagans, idolaters, those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allah and deny the Prophethood of Messenger Muhammad SAW).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 87","secondaryText":"وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=22","body":"(Some) say they were three, the dog being the fourth among them; (others) say they were five, the dog being the sixth, guessing at the unseen; (yet others) say they were seven, the dog being the eighth. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=21","body":"Have they not travelled in the land and seen what was the end of those who were before them?
