And none had they to protect them from Allah.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 21","secondaryText":"۞ أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=1","body":"O you who believe! Fulfill (your) obligations. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=43","body":"But how do they come to you for decision while they have the Taurat (Torah), in which is the (plain) Decision of Allah; yet even after that, they turn away. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=2","body":"Whatever of mercy (i.e. of good), Allah may grant to mankind, none can withhold it, and whatever He may withhold, none can grant it thereafter. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=37","body":"They will long to get out of the Fire, but never will they get out therefrom, and theirs will be a lasting torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 37","secondaryText":"يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَٰرِجِينَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّقِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=80","body":"And Allah has made for you in your homes an abode, and made for you out of the hides of the cattle (tents for) dwelling, which you find so light (and handy) when you travel and when you stay (in your travels), and of their wool, fur, and hair (sheep wool, camel fur, and goat hair), a furnishing and articles of convenience (e.g. carpets, blankets, etc.), a comfort for a while.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 80","secondaryText":"وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بُيُوتًۭا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثًۭا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=123","body":"Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said: \"You have believed in him [Musa (Moses)] before I give you permission. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=52","body":"Certainly, We have brought to them a Book (the Quran) which We have explained in detail with knowledge, - a guidance and a mercy to a people who believe.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَٰهُم بِكِتَٰبٍۢ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ هُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=114","body":"He (Allah) will say: \"You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 114","secondaryText":"قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/27?startingVerse=69","body":"Say to them (O Muhammad SAW) \"Travel in the land and see how has been the end of the criminals (those who denied Allah's Messengers and disobeyed Allah).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Naml","reference":"Ayah 69","secondaryText":"قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=36","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW): \"Verily, my Lord enlarges and restricts the provision to whom He pleases, but most men know not.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saba","reference":"Ayah 36","secondaryText":"قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/58?startingVerse=18","body":"On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together (for their account), then they will swear to Him as they swear to you (O Muslims). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=26","body":"Those before them indeed plotted, but Allah struck at the foundation of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them, from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 26","secondaryText":"قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/14?startingVerse=29","body":"Hell, in which they will burn, - and what an evil place to settle in!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ibrahim","reference":"Ayah 29","secondaryText":"جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/36?startingVerse=56","body":"They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yaseen","reference":"Ayah 56","secondaryText":"هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=88","body":"Those who disbelieved and hinder (men) from the Path of Allah, for them We will add torment over the torment; because they used to spread corruption [by disobeying Allah themselves, as well as ordering others (mankind) to do so].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 88","secondaryText":"ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَٰهُمْ عَذَابًۭا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/1?startingVerse=7","body":"The Way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace, not (the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Faatiha","reference":"Ayah 7","secondaryText":"صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=139","body":"Say (O Muhammad Peace be upon him to the Jews and Christians), \"Dispute you with us about Allah while He is our Lord and your Lord? And we are to be rewarded for our deeds and you for your deeds. And we are sincere to Him in worship and obedience (i.e. we worship Him Alone and none else, and we obey His Orders).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 139","secondaryText":"قُلْ أَتُحَآجُّونَنَا فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ وَلَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُخْلِصُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=221","body":"And do not marry Al-Mushrikat (idolatresses, etc.) till they believe (worship Allah Alone). And indeed a slave woman who believes is better than a (free) Mushrikah (idolatress, etc.), even though she pleases you. And give not (your daughters) in marriage to Al-Mushrikun till they believe (in Allah Alone) and verily, a believing slave is better than a (free) Mushrik (idolater, etc.), even though he pleases you. Those (Al-Mushrikun) invite you to the Fire, but Allah invites (you) to Paradise and Forgiveness by His Leave, and makes His Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) clear to mankind that they may remember.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 221","secondaryText":"وَلَا تَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنَّ ۚ وَلَأَمَةٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَةٌ خَيْرٌۭ مِّن مُّشْرِكَةٍۢ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تُنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ وَلَعَبْدٌۭ مُّؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌۭ مِّن مُّشْرِكٍۢ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ وَيُبَيِّنُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/68?startingVerse=4","body":"And verily, you (O Muhammad SAW) are on an exalted standard of character.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qalam","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=15","body":"Whoever goes right, then he goes right only for the benefit of his ownself. And whoever goes astray, then he goes astray to his own loss. And We never punish until We have sent a Messenger (to give warning).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Israa","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=95","body":"And purchase not a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant. Verily! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=54","body":"And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it (this Quran) is the truth from your Lord, and that they may believe therein, and their hearts may submit to it with humility. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=71","body":"(And remember) the Day when We shall call together all human beings with their (respective) Imam [their Prophets, or their records of good and bad deeds, or their Holy Books like the Quran, the Taurat (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), etc.]. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=155","body":"Because of their breaking the covenant, and of their rejecting the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allah, and of their killing the Prophets unjustly, and of their saying: \"Our hearts are wrapped (with coverings, i.e. we do not understand what the Messengers say)\" - nay, Allah has set a seal upon their hearts because of their disbelief, so they believe not but a little.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 155","secondaryText":"فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَٰقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِم بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۢ وَقَوْلِهِمْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ ۚ بَلْ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=83","body":"And (remember) when We took a covenant from the Children of Israel, (saying): Worship none but Allah (Alone) and be dutiful and good to parents, and to kindred, and to orphans and Al-Masakin (the poor), [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 10, Page 158 (Verse 9:60)] and speak good to people [i.e. enjoin righteousness and forbid evil, and say the truth about Muhammad Peace be upon him], and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), and give Zakat. Then you slid back, except a few of you, while you are backsliders. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=6","body":"And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you (O Muhammad SAW) from your Lord is the truth, and guides to the Path of the Exalted in Might, Owner of all praise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saba","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=46","body":"To Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allah).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 46","secondaryText":"إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=97","body":"Musa (Moses) said: \"Then go away! And verily, your (punishment) in this life will be that you will say: \"Touch me not (i.e. you will live alone exiled away from mankind); and verily (for a future torment), you have a promise that will not fail. And look at your ilah (god), to which you have been devoted. We will certainly burn it, and scatter its particles in the sea.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 97","secondaryText":"قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=52","body":"The Day when their excuses will be of no profit to Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah). Theirs will be the curse, and theirs will be the evil abode (i.e. painful torment in Hell-fire).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/58?startingVerse=17","body":"Their children and their wealth will avail them nothing against Allah. They will be (the) dwellers of the Fire, to dwell therein forever.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Mujaadila","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"لَّن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/47?startingVerse=16","body":"And among them are some who listen to you (O Muhammad SAW) till, when they go out from you, they say to those who have received knowledge: \"What has he said just now? Such are men whose hearts Allah has sealed, and they follow their lusts (evil desires).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Muhammad","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=57","body":"Those whom they call upon [like 'Iesa (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), 'Uzair (Ezra), angel, etc.] desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord (Allah), as to which of them should be the nearest and they ['Iesa (Jesus), 'Uzair (Ezra), angels, etc.] hope for His Mercy and fear His Torment. Verily, the Torment of your Lord is something to be afraid of!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Israa","reference":"Ayah 57","secondaryText":"أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=61","body":"Is he whom We have promised an excellent promise (Paradise), which he will find true, like him whom We have made to enjoy the luxuries of the life of (this) world, then on the Day of Resurrection, he will be among those brought up (to be punished in the Hell-fire)?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 61","secondaryText":"أَفَمَن وَعَدْنَٰهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًۭا فَهُوَ لَٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُ مَتَٰعَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=23","body":"Truly, Allah will admit those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, to Gardens underneath which rivers flow (in Paradise), wherein they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls and their garments therein will be of silk.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=189","body":"They ask you (O Muhammad SAW) about the new moons. Say: These are signs to mark fixed periods of time for mankind and for the pilgrimage. It is not Al-Birr (piety, righteousness, etc.) that you enter the houses from the back but Al-Birr (is the quality of the one) who fears Allah. So enter houses through their proper doors, and fear Allah that you may be successful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 189","secondaryText":"۞ يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَهِلَّةِ ۖ قُلْ هِىَ مَوَٰقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ وَٱلْحَجِّ ۗ وَلَيْسَ ٱلْبِرُّ بِأَن تَأْتُوا۟ ٱلْبُيُوتَ مِن ظُهُورِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ مَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ ۗ وَأْتُوا۟ ٱلْبُيُوتَ مِنْ أَبْوَٰبِهَا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/53?startingVerse=41","body":"Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Najm","reference":"Ayah 41","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/67?startingVerse=17","body":"Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allah), will not send against you a violent whirlwind? Then you shall know how (terrible) has been My Warning?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Mulk","reference":"Ayah 17","secondaryText":"أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=119","body":"Lo! You are the ones who love them but they love you not, and you believe in all the Scriptures [i.e. you believe in the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), while they disbelieve in your Book, the Quran]. And when they meet you, they say, \"We believe\". But when they are alone, they bite the tips of their fingers at you in rage. Say: \"Perish in your rage. Certainly, Allah knows what is in the breasts (all the secrets).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 119","secondaryText":"هَٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ عَضُّوا۟ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۚ قُلْ مُوتُوا۟ بِغَيْظِكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/56?startingVerse=68","body":"Tell Me! The water that you drink.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Waaqia","reference":"Ayah 68","secondaryText":"أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/56?startingVerse=16","body":"Reclining thereon, face to face.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Waaqia","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=108","body":"\"So fear Allah, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 108","secondaryText":"فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=174","body":"Verily, those who conceal what Allah has sent down of the Book, and purchase a small gain therewith (of worldly things), they eat into their bellies nothing but fire. Allah will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor purify them, and theirs will be a painful torment.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 174","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَيَشْتَرُونَ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا ۙ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِى بُطُونِهِمْ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=111","body":"And I know not, perhaps it may be a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 111","secondaryText":"وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=4","body":"Aforetime, as a guidance to mankind, And He sent down the criterion [of judgement between right and wrong (this Quran)]. Truly, those who disbelieve in the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allah, for them there is a severe torment; and Allah is All-Mighty, All-Able of Retribution.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"مِن قَبْلُ هُدًۭى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=173","body":"And We rained on them a rain (of torment). And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 173","secondaryText":"وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/50?startingVerse=15","body":"Were We then tired with the first creation? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=108","body":"And they say: \"Glory be to our Lord! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/53?startingVerse=30","body":"That is what they could reach of knowledge. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=238","body":"Guard strictly (five obligatory) As-Salawat (the prayers) especially the middle Salat (i.e. the best prayer - 'Asr). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/92?startingVerse=7","body":"We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Lail","reference":"Ayah 7","secondaryText":"فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=149","body":"Now ask them (O Muhammad SAW): \"Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 149","secondaryText":"فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=16","body":"And as for those who disbelieved and belied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, Allah's Messengers, Resurrection, etc.), and the Meeting of the Hereafter, such shall be brought forth to the torment (in the Hell-fire).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Room","reference":"Ayah 16","secondaryText":"وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=23","body":"And that thought of yours which you thought about your Lord, has brought you to destruction, and you have become (this Day) of those utterly lost!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Fussilat","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/54?startingVerse=47","body":"Verily, the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.) are in error (in this world) and will burn (in the Hell-fire in the Hereafter).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qamar","reference":"Ayah 47","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=47","body":"They said: \"Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 47","secondaryText":"فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=5","body":"Made lawful to you this day are At-Tayyibat [all kinds of Halal (lawful) foods, which Allah has made lawful (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, etc., milk products, fats, vegetables and fruits, etc.). The food (slaughtered cattle, eatable animals, etc.) of the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) is lawful to you and yours is lawful to them. (Lawful to you in marriage) are chaste women from the believers and chaste women from those who were given the Scripture (Jews and Christians) before your time, when you have given their due Mahr (bridal money given by the husband to his wife at the time of marriage), desiring chastity (i.e. taking them in legal wedlock) not committing illegal sexual intercourse, nor taking them as girl-friends. And whosoever disbelieves in the Oneness of Allah and in all the other Articles of Faith [i.e. His (Allah's), Angels, His Holy Books, His Messengers, the Day of Resurrection and Al-Qadar (Divine Preordainments)], then fruitless is his work, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"ٱلْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ ۖ وَطَعَامُ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ حِلٌّۭ لَّكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّۭ لَّهُمْ ۖ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَٰفِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِىٓ أَخْدَانٍۢ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُۥ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/62?startingVerse=5","body":"The likeness of those who were entrusted with the (obligation of the) Taurat (Torah) (i.e. to obey its commandments and to practise its legal laws), but who subsequently failed in those (obligations), is as the likeness of a donkey who carries huge burdens of books (but understands nothing from them). How bad is the example (or the likeness) of people who deny the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allah. And Allah guides not the people who are Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Jumu'a","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًۢا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=43","body":"And indeed We gave Musa (Moses), after We had destroyed the generations of old, the Scripture [the Taurat (Torah)] as an enlightenment for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy, that they might remember (or receive admonition).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 43","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْقُرُونَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=45","body":"Recite (O Muhammad SAW) what has been revealed to you of the Book (the Quran), and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=67","body":"For every nation We have ordained religious ceremonies [e.g. slaughtering of the beast of cattle during the three days of stay at Mina (Makkah) during the Hajj (pilgrimage)] which they must follow; so let them (pagans) not dispute with you on the matter (i.e. to eat of the cattle which you slaughter, and not to eat of cattle which Allah kills by its natural death), but invite them to your Lord. Verily! You (O Muhammad SAW) indeed are on the (true) straight guidance. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=34","body":"And indeed Yusuf (Joseph) did come to you, in times gone by, with clear signs, but you ceased not to doubt in that which he did bring to you, till when he died you said: \"No Messenger will Allah send after him.\" Thus Allah leaves astray him who is a Musrif (a polytheist, oppressor, a criminal, sinner who commit great sins) and a Murtab (one who doubts Allah's Warning and His Oneness).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 34","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=121","body":"Eat not (O believers) of that (meat) on which Allah's Name has not been pronounced (at the time of the slaughtering of the animal), for sure it is Fisq (a sin and disobedience of Allah). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=73","body":"And to Thamud (people, We sent) their brother Salih (Saleh). He said: \"O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=13","body":"And when a party of them said: \"O people of Yathrib (AlMadinah)! There is no stand (possible) for you (against the enemy attack!) title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/13?startingVerse=18","body":"For those who answered their Lord's Call [believed in the Oneness of Allah and followed His Messenger Muhammad SAW i.e. Islamic Monotheism] is Al-Husna (i.e. Paradise). For them there will be the terrible reckoning. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=69","body":"Like those before you, they were mightier than you in power, and more abundant in wealth and children. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=60","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW to the people of the Scripture): \"Shall I inform you of something worse than that, regarding the recompense from Allah: those (Jews) who incurred the Curse of Allah and His Wrath, those of whom (some) He transformed into monkeys and swines, those who worshipped Taghut (false deities); such are worse in rank (on the Day of Resurrection in the Hell-fire), and far more astray from the Right Path (in the life of this world).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 60","secondaryText":"قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَن لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْقِرَدَةَ وَٱلْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=76","body":"Then when He gave them of His Bounty, they became niggardly [refused to pay the Sadaqah (Zakat or voluntary charity)], and turned away, averse.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 76","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ بَخِلُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=65","body":"If you ask them (about this), they declare: \"We were only talking idly and joking.\" Say: \"Was it at Allah, and His Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and His Messenger (SAW) that you were mocking?\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 65","secondaryText":"وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّمَا كُنَّا نَخُوضُ وَنَلْعَبُ ۚ قُلْ أَبِٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَرَسُولِهِۦ كُنتُمْ تَسْتَهْزِءُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=90","body":"And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Fir'aun (Pharaoh) with his hosts followed them in oppression and enmity, till when drowning overtook him, he said: \"I believe that La ilaha illa (Huwa): (none has the right to be worshipped but) He,\" in Whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am one of the Muslims (those who submit to Allah's Will).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 90","secondaryText":"۞ وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ بَغْيًۭا وَعَدْوًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَدْرَكَهُ ٱلْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنتُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَتْ بِهِۦ بَنُوٓا۟ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=71","body":"And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds, then verily, he repents towards Allah with true repentance.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Furqaan","reference":"Ayah 71","secondaryText":"وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=106","body":"Follow what has been inspired to you (O Muhammad SAW) from your Lord, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) and turn aside from Al-Mushrikun.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 106","secondaryText":"ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=60","body":"And when it is said to them: \"Prostrate to the Most Beneficent (Allah)! They say: \"And what is the Most Beneficent? data: {"url":"https://quran.com/44?startingVerse=46","body":"Like the boiling of scalding water.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ad-Dukhaan","reference":"Ayah 46","secondaryText":"كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/23?startingVerse=14","body":"Then We made the Nutfah into a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood), then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muminoon","reference":"Ayah 14","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/36?startingVerse=42","body":"And We have created for them of the like thereunto, so on them they ride.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yaseen","reference":"Ayah 42","secondaryText":"وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/19?startingVerse=8","body":"He said: \"My Lord! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=72","body":"She said (in astonishment): \"Woe unto me! Shall I bear a child while I am an old woman, and here is my husband, an old man? Verily! This is a strange thing!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 72","secondaryText":"قَالَتْ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌۭ وَهَٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/38?startingVerse=23","body":"Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: \"Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saad","reference":"Ayah 23","secondaryText":"إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/61?startingVerse=4","body":"Verily, Allah loves those who fight in His Cause in rows (ranks) as if they were a solid structure.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saff","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفًّۭا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَٰنٌۭ مَّرْصُوصٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=105","body":"And they ask you concerning the mountains, say; \"My Lord will blast them and scatter them as particles of dust.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 105","secondaryText":"وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=164","body":"And when a community among them said: \"Why do you preach to a people whom Allah is about to destroy or to punish with a severe torment?\" (The preachers) said: \"In order to be free from guilt before your Lord (Allah), and perhaps they may fear Allah.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 164","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا ۙ ٱللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ قَالُوا۟ مَعْذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=10","body":"Then evil was the end of those who did evil, because they belied the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, Messengers, etc.) of Allah and made mock of them.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Room","reference":"Ayah 10","secondaryText":"ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=29","body":"And let not your hand be tied (like a miser) to your neck, nor stretch it forth to its utmost reach (like a spendthrift), so that you become blameworthy and in severe poverty.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Israa","reference":"Ayah 29","secondaryText":"وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًۭا مَّحْسُورًا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=77","body":"So they killed the she-camel and insolently defied the Commandment of their Lord, and said: \"O Salih (Saleh)! Bring about your threats if you are indeed one of the Messengers (of Allah).\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 77","secondaryText":"فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰصَٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/54?startingVerse=3","body":"They belied (the Verses of Allah, this Quran), and followed their own lusts. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=136","body":"They said: \"It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 136","secondaryText":"قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=85","body":"So because of what they said, Allah rewarded them Gardens under which rivers flow (in Paradise), they will abide therein forever. Such is the reward of good-doers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 85","secondaryText":"فَأَثَٰبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=31","body":"(Always) Turning in repentance to Him (only), and be afraid and dutiful to Him; and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and be not of Al-Mushrikun (the disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, polytheists, idolaters, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Room","reference":"Ayah 31","secondaryText":"۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/17?startingVerse=60","body":"And (remember) when We told you: \"Verily! Your Lord has encompassed mankind (i.e. they are in His Grip).\" And We made not the vision which we showed you (O Muhammad as an actual eye-witness and not as a dream on the night of Al-Isra') but a trial for mankind, and likewise the accursed tree (Zaqqum, mentioned) in the Quran. We warn and make them afraid but it only increases them in naught save great disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allah.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Israa","reference":"Ayah 60","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًۭا كَبِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=24","body":"On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their legs or feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Noor","reference":"Ayah 24","secondaryText":"يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/81?startingVerse=25","body":"And it (the Quran) is not the word of the outcast Shaitan (Satan).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Takwir","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/31?startingVerse=12","body":"And indeed We bestowed upon Luqman Al-Hikmah (wisdom and religious understanding, etc.) saying: \"Give thanks to Allah,\" and whoever gives thanks, he gives thanks for (the good of) his ownself. And whoever is unthankful, then verily, Allah is All-Rich (Free of all wants), Worthy of all praise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Luqman","reference":"Ayah 12","secondaryText":"وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/67?startingVerse=20","body":"Who is he besides the Most Beneficent that can be an army to you to help you? data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=37","body":"And (remember) when you said to him (Zaid bin Harithah, the freedslave of the Prophet SAW) on whom Allah has bestowed Grace (by guiding him to Islam) and you (O Muhammad SAW too) have done favour (by manumitting him) \"Keep your wife to yourself, and fear Allah.\" But you did hide in yourself (i.e. what Allah has already made known to you that He will give her to you in marriage) that which Allah will make manifest, you did fear the people (i.e., Muhammad SAW married the divorced wife of his manumitted slave) whereas Allah had a better right that you should fear Him. So when Zaid had accomplished his desire from her (i.e. divorced her), We gave her to you in marriage, so that (in future) there may be no difficulty to the believers in respect of (the marriage of) the wives of their adopted sons when the latter have no desire to keep them (i.e. they have divorced them). And Allah's Command must be fulfilled.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 37","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=68","body":"Say (O Muhammad SAW) \"O people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians)! You have nothing (as regards guidance) till you act according to the Taurat (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), and what has (now) been sent down to you from your Lord (the Quran).\" Verily, that which has been sent down to you (Muhammad SAW) from your Lord increases in many of them their obstinate rebellion and disbelief. So be not sorrowful over the people who disbelieve.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 68","secondaryText":"قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۗ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا ۖ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/30?startingVerse=47","body":"And indeed We did send Messengers before you (O Muhammad SAW) to their own peoples. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=59","body":"Indeed, We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people and he said: \"O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him. (La ilaha ill-Allah: none has the right to be worshipped but Allah). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=10","body":"Those who disbelieve will be addressed (at the time of entering into the Fire): \"Allah's aversion was greater towards you (in the worldly life when you used to reject the Faith) than your aversion towards one another (now in the Fire of Hell, as you are now enemies to one another), when you were called to the Faith but you used to refuse.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 10","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=81","body":"And Allah has made for you out of that which He has created shades, and has made for you places of refuge in the mountains, and has made for you garments to protect you from the heat (and cold), and coats of mail to protect you from your (mutual) violence. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/29?startingVerse=11","body":"Verily, Allah knows those who believe, and verily, He knows the hypocrites [i.e. Allah will test the people with good and hard days to discriminate the good from the wicked (although Allah knows all that before putting them to test)].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ankaboot","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/45?startingVerse=10","body":"In front of them there is Hell, and that which they have earned will be of no profit to them, nor (will be of any profit to them) those whom they have taken as Auliya' (protectors, helpers, etc.) besides Allah. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=137","body":"Verily, those who believe, then disbelieve, then believe (again), and (again) disbelieve, and go on increasing in disbelief; Allah will not forgive them, nor guide them on the (Right) Way.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 137","secondaryText":"إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًۭا لَّمْ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ سَبِيلًۢا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=65","body":"Say: \"He has power to send torment on you from above or from under your feet, or to cover you with confusion in party strife, and make you to taste the violence of one another.\" See how variously We explain the Ayat (proofs, evidences, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), so that they may understand.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 65","secondaryText":"قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًۭا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًۭا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=91","body":"You will find others that wish to have security from you and security from their people. Every time they are sent back to temptation, they yield thereto. If they withdraw not from you, nor offer you peace, nor restrain their hands, take (hold) of them and kill them wherever you find them. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/50?startingVerse=19","body":"And the stupor of death will come in truth: \"This is what you have been avoiding!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Qaaf","reference":"Ayah 19","secondaryText":"وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=15","body":"Say: (O Muhammad SAW) \"Is that (torment) better or the Paradise of Eternity promised to the Muttaqun (pious and righteous persons - see V. 2:2)?\" It will be theirs as a reward and as a final destination.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Furqaan","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَمَصِيرًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=107","body":"And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW) not but as a mercy for the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 107","secondaryText":"وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=31","body":"Say (O MuhammadSAW): \"Who provides for you from the sky and from the earth? Or who owns hearing and sight? title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/90?startingVerse=19","body":"But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Balad","reference":"Ayah 19","secondaryText":"وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=35","body":"Or they (the pagans of Makkah) say: \"He (Muhammad SAW) has fabricated it (the Quran).\" Say: \"If I have fabricated it, upon me be my crimes, but I am innocent of (all) those crimes which you commit.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 35","secondaryText":"أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَعَلَىَّ إِجْرَامِى وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=155","body":"Those of you who turned back on the day the two hosts met (i.e. the battle of Uhud), it was Shaitan (Satan) who caused them to backslide (run away from the battlefield) because of some (sins) they had earned. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/62?startingVerse=9","body":"O you who believe (Muslims)! title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=95","body":"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home), except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame, etc.), and those who strive hard and fight in the Cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives. Unto each, Allah has promised good (Paradise), but Allah has preferred those who strive hard and fight, above those who sit (at home) by a huge reward;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nisaa","reference":"Ayah 95","secondaryText":"لَّا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْقَٰعِدُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ غَيْرُ أُو۟لِى ٱلضَّرَرِ وَٱلْمُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ عَلَى ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ دَرَجَةًۭ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَفَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=3","body":"The adulterer marries not but an adulteress or a Mushrikah and the adulteress none marries her except an adulterer or a Muskrik [and that means that the man who agrees to marry (have a sexual relation with) a Mushrikah (female polytheist, pagan or idolatress) or a prostitute, then surely he is either an adulterer, or a Mushrik (polytheist, pagan or idolater, etc.) And the woman who agrees to marry (have a sexual relation with) a Mushrik (polytheist, pagan or idolater) or an adulterer, then she is either a prostitute or a Mushrikah (female polytheist, pagan, or idolatress, etc.)]. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=68","body":"They said, \"Call upon your Lord for us that He may make plain to us what it is!\" He said, \"He says, 'Verily, it is a cow neither too old nor too young, but (it is) between the two conditions', so do what you are commanded.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 68","secondaryText":"قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌۭ لَّا فَارِضٌۭ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌۢ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَٱفْعَلُوا۟ مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=5","body":"The people of Nuh (Noah) and the confederates after them denied (their Messengers) before these, and every (disbelieving) nation plotted against their Messenger to seize him, and disputed by means of falsehood to refute therewith the truth. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/13?startingVerse=27","body":"And those who disbelieve say: \"Why is not a sign sent down to him (Muhammad SAW) from his Lord?\" Say: \"Verily, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides unto Himself those who turn to Him in repentance.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ar-Ra'd","reference":"Ayah 27","secondaryText":"وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=11","body":"And among mankind is he who worships Allah as it were, upon the very edge (i.e. in doubt); if good befalls him, he is content therewith; but if a trial befalls him, he turns back on his face (i.e. reverts back to disbelief after embracing Islam). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=229","body":"The divorce is twice, after that, either you retain her on reasonable terms or release her with kindness. And it is not lawful for you (men) to take back (from your wives) any of your Mahr (bridal money given by the husband to his wife at the time of marriage) which you have given them, except when both parties fear that they would be unable to keep the limits ordained by Allah (e.g. to deal with each other on a fair basis). Then if you fear that they would not be able to keep the limits ordained by Allah, then there is no sin on either of them if she gives back (the Mahr or a part of it) for her Al-Khul' (divorce). These are the limits ordained by Allah, so do not transgress them. And whoever transgresses the limits ordained by Allah, then such are the Zalimun (wrong-doers, etc.).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 229","secondaryText":"ٱلطَّلَٰقُ مَرَّتَانِ ۖ فَإِمْسَاكٌۢ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌۢ بِإِحْسَٰنٍۢ ۗ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَن تَأْخُذُوا۟ مِمَّآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّآ أَن يَخَافَآ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا ٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=6","body":"Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs), will they then believe?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ"}

title: The Quran

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/37?startingVerse=11","body":"Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad SAW): \"Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains, etc.) whom We have created?\" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saaffaat","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=138","body":"And We brought the Children of Israel (with safety) across the sea, and they came upon a people devoted to some of their idols (in worship). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=40","body":"If you help him (Muhammad SAW) not (it does not matter), for Allah did indeed help him when the disbelievers drove him out, the second of two, when they (Muhammad SAW and Abu Bakr) were in the cave, and he (SAW) said to his companion (Abu Bakr): \"Be not sad (or afraid), surely Allah is with us.\" Then Allah sent down His Sakinah (calmness, tranquillity, peace, etc.) upon him, and strengthened him with forces (angels) which you saw not, and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowermost, while it was the Word of Allah that became the uppermost, and Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 40","secondaryText":"إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثَانِىَ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِى ٱلْغَارِ إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا ۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلسُّفْلَىٰ ۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِىَ ٱلْعُلْيَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/80?startingVerse=6","body":"To him you attend;","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Abasa","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/6?startingVerse=7","body":"And even if We had sent down unto you (O Muhammad SAW) a Message written on paper so that they could touch it with their hands, the disbelievers would have said: \"This is nothing but obvious magic!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-An'aam","reference":"Ayah 7","secondaryText":"وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًۭا فِى قِرْطَاسٍۢ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/65?startingVerse=2","body":"Then when they are about to fulfil their term appointed, either take them back in a good manner or part with them in a good manner. And take for witness two just persons from among you (Muslims). And establish the witness for Allah. That will be an admonition given to him who believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever fears Allah and keeps his duty to Him, He will make a way for him to get out (from every difficulty).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Talaaq","reference":"Ayah 2","secondaryText":"فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/61?startingVerse=3","body":"Most hateful it is with Allah that you say that which you do not do.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saff","reference":"Ayah 3","secondaryText":"كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/28?startingVerse=6","body":"And to establish them in the land, and We let Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and Haman and their hosts receive from them that which they feared.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Qasas","reference":"Ayah 6","secondaryText":"وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=137","body":"And We made the people who were considered weak to inherit the eastern parts of the land and the western parts thereof which We have blessed. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=125","body":"But as for those in whose hearts is a disease (of doubt, disbelief and hypocrisy), it will add suspicion and doubt to their suspicion, disbelief and doubt, and they die while they are disbelievers.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 125","secondaryText":"وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ فَزَادَتْهُمْ رِجْسًا إِلَىٰ رِجْسِهِمْ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/42?startingVerse=32","body":"And among His Signs are the ships, in the sea, like mountains.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shura","reference":"Ayah 32","secondaryText":"وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/57?startingVerse=11","body":"Who is he that will lend to Allah a goodly loan, then (Allah) will increase it manifold to his credit (in repaying), and he will have (besides) a good reward (i.e. Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hadid","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/35?startingVerse=7","body":"Those who disbelieve, theirs will be a severe torment; and those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (i.e. Paradise).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Faatir","reference":"Ayah 7","secondaryText":"ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=73","body":"So that Allah will punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the men and women who are AlMushrikun (the polytheists, idolaters, pagans, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, and in His Messenger Muhammad SAW). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/10?startingVerse=43","body":"And among them are some who look at you, but can you guide the blind, even though they see not?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Yunus","reference":"Ayah 43","secondaryText":"وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=51","body":"You (O Muhammad SAW) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives), and you may receive whom you will. And Allah is Ever AllKnowing, Most Forbearing.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Ahzaab","reference":"Ayah 51","secondaryText":"۞ تُرْجِى مَن تَشَآءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِىٓ إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=161","body":"When their brother Lout (Lot) said to them: \"Will you not fear Allah and obey Him?","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 161","secondaryText":"إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=5","body":"They are on (true) guidance from their Lord, and they are the successful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 5","secondaryText":"أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/44?startingVerse=39","body":"We created them not except with truth (i.e. to examine and test those who are obedient and those who are disobedient and then reward the obedient ones and punish the disobedient ones), but most of them know not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ad-Dukhaan","reference":"Ayah 39","secondaryText":"مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/95?startingVerse=4","body":"Verily, We created man of the best stature (mould),","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tin","reference":"Ayah 4","secondaryText":"لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/40?startingVerse=49","body":"And those in the Fire will say to the keepers (angels) of Hell: \"Call upon your Lord to lighten for us the torment for a day!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ghafir","reference":"Ayah 49","secondaryText":"وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=32","body":"Because of that We ordained for the Children of Israel that if anyone killed a person not in retaliation of murder, or (and) to spread mischief in the land - it would be as if he killed all mankind, and if anyone saved a life, it would be as if he saved the life of all mankind. And indeed, there came to them Our Messengers with clear proofs, evidences, and signs, even then after that many of them continued to exceed the limits (e.g. by doing oppression unjustly and exceeding beyond the limits set by Allah by committing the major sins) in the land!.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 32","secondaryText":"مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُۥ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًۢا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحْيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/19?startingVerse=84","body":"So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (of the days of the life of this world and delay their term so that they may increase in evil and sins).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Maryam","reference":"Ayah 84","secondaryText":"فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=94","body":"He [Harun (Aaron)] said: \"O son of my mother! Seize (me) not by my beard, nor by my head! Verily, I feared lest you should say: 'You have caused a division among the Children of Israel, and you have not respected my word!' \"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 94","secondaryText":"قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=91","body":"And when it is said to them (the Jews), \"Believe in what Allah has sent down,\" they say, \"We believe in what was sent down to us.\" And they disbelieve in that which came after it, while it is the truth confirming what is with them. data: {"url":"https://quran.com/48?startingVerse=11","body":"Those of the bedouins who lagged behind will say to you: \"Our possessions and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us.\" They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=213","body":"Mankind were one community and Allah sent Prophets with glad tidings and warnings, and with them He sent the Scripture in truth to judge between people in matters wherein they differed. And only those to whom (the Scripture) was given differed concerning it after clear proofs had come unto them through hatred, one to another. Then Allah by His Leave guided those who believed to the truth of that wherein they differed. And Allah guides whom He wills to a Straight Path.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 213","secondaryText":"كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَأَنزَلَ مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فِيمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ فِيهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ فَهَدَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=73","body":"Surely, disbelievers are those who said: \"Allah is the third of the three (in a Trinity).\" But there is no ilah (god) (none who has the right to be worshipped) but One Ilah (God -Allah). title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=28","body":"O you who believe (in Allah's Oneness and in His Messenger (Muhammad SAW)! Verily, the Mushrikun (polytheists, pagans, idolaters, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, and in the Message of Muhammad SAW) are Najasun (impure). So let them not come near Al-Masjid-al-Haram (at Makkah) after this year, and if you fear poverty, Allah will enrich you if He will, out of His Bounty. Surely, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 28","secondaryText":"يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌۭ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةًۭ فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِن شَآءَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/25?startingVerse=36","body":"And We said: \"Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.).\" Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Furqaan","reference":"Ayah 36","secondaryText":"فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًۭا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/3?startingVerse=183","body":"Those (Jews) who said: \"Verily, Allah has taken our promise not to believe in any Messenger unless he brings to us an offering which the fire (from heaven) shall devour.\" Say: \"Verily, there came to you Messengers before me, with clear signs and even with what you speak of; why then did you kill them, if you are truthful?\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Aal-i-Imraan","reference":"Ayah 183","secondaryText":"ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَآ أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍۢ تَأْكُلُهُ ٱلنَّارُ ۗ قُلْ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِى بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلَّذِى قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/41?startingVerse=39","body":"And among His Signs (in this), that you see the earth barren, but when We send down water (rain) to it, it is stirred to life and growth (of vegetations). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/24?startingVerse=40","body":"Or [the state of a disbeliever] is like the darkness in a vast deep sea, overwhelmed with a great wave topped by a great wave, topped by dark clouds, darkness, one above another, if a man stretches out his hand, he can hardly see it! data: {"url":"https://quran.com/39?startingVerse=49","body":"When harm touches man, he calls to Us (for help), then when We have (rescued him from that harm and) changed it into a favour from Us, he says: \"Only because of knowledge (that I possess) I obtained it.\" Nay, it is only a trial, but most of them know not!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Az-Zumar","reference":"Ayah 49","secondaryText":"فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَٰهُ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=97","body":"Whoever works righteousness, whether male or female, while he (or she) is a true believer (of Islamic Monotheism) verily, to him We will give a good life (in this world with respect, contentment and lawful provision), and We shall pay them certainly a reward in proportion to the best of what they used to do (i.e. Paradise in the Hereafter).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 97","secondaryText":"مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=50","body":"And (remember) when We said to the angels; \"Prostrate to Adam.\" So they prostrated except Iblis (Satan). He was one of the jinns; he disobeyed the Command of his Lord. Will you then take him (Iblis) and his offspring as protectors and helpers rather than Me while they are enemies to you? What an evil is the exchange for the Zalimun (polytheists, and wrong-doers, etc).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 50","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًۭا"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/67?startingVerse=27","body":"But when they will see it (the torment on the Day of Resurrection) approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be different (black, sad, and in grieve), and it will be said (to them): \"This is (the promise) which you were calling for!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Mulk","reference":"Ayah 27","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/33?startingVerse=19","body":"Being miserly towards you (as regards help and aid in Allah's Cause). data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=160","body":"And We divided them into twelve tribes (as distinct) nations.
