title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=63","body":"Why do not the rabbis and the religious learned men forbid them from uttering sinful words and from eating illegal things. Evil indeed is that which they have been performing.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 63","secondaryText":"لَوْلَا يَنْهَىٰهُمُ ٱلرَّبَّٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ ٱلْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=112","body":"He (Muhammad SAW) said:\"My Lord! Judge You in truth! Our Lord is the Most Beneficent, Whose Help is to be sought against that which you attribute (unto Allah that He has offspring, and unto Muhammad SAW that he is a sorcerer, and unto the Quran that it is poetry, etc.)!\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 112","secondaryText":"قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/16?startingVerse=43","body":"And We sent not (as Our Messengers) before you (O Muhammad SAW) any but men, whom We inspired, (to preach and invite mankind to believe in the Oneness of Allah). So ask of those who know the Scripture [learned men of the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)], if you know not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah An-Nahl","reference":"Ayah 43","secondaryText":"وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=18","body":"Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Quran) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Us) (against Allah by uttering that Allah has a wife and a son).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/22?startingVerse=52","body":"Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you, but; when he did recite the revelation or narrated or spoke, Shaitan (Satan) threw (some falsehood) in it. But Allah abolishes that which Shaitan (Satan) throws in. Then Allah establishes His Revelations. And Allah is All-Knower, All-Wise:","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hajj","reference":"Ayah 52","secondaryText":"وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/5?startingVerse=116","body":"And (remember) when Allah will say (on the Day of Resurrection): \"O 'Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)! Did you say unto men: 'Worship me and my mother as two gods besides Allah?' \" He will say: \"Glory be to You! It was not for me to say what I had no right (to say). Had I said such a thing, You would surely have known it. You know what is in my inner-self though I do not know what is in Yours, truly, You, only You, are the All-Knower of all that is hidden and unseen.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Maaida","reference":"Ayah 116","secondaryText":"وَإِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِى وَأُمِّىَ إِلَٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِحَقٍّ ۚ إِن كُنتُ قُلْتُهُۥ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُۥ ۚ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِى وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِكَ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/11?startingVerse=74","body":"Then when the fear had gone away from (the mind of) Ibrahim (Abraham), and the glad tidings had reached him, he began to plead with Us (Our Messengers) for the people of Lout (Lot).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Hud","reference":"Ayah 74","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ وَجَآءَتْهُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=140","body":"Or say you that Ibrahim (Abraham), Isma'il (Ishmael), Ishaque (Isaac), Ya'qub (Jacob) and Al-Asbat [the twelve sons of Ya'qub (Jacob)] were Jews or Christians? Say, \"Do you know better or does Allah (knows better\u0085 that they all were Muslims)? And who is more unjust than he who conceals the testimony [i.e. to believe in Prophet Muhammad Peace be upon him when he comes, written in their Books. (See Verse 7:157)] he has from Allah? And Allah is not unaware of what you do.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 140","secondaryText":"أَمْ تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطَ كَانُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ ۗ قُلْ ءَأَنتُمْ أَعْلَمُ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَتَمَ شَهَٰدَةً عِندَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/15?startingVerse=22","body":"And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then caused the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We gave it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like].","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Hijr","reference":"Ayah 22","secondaryText":"وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/7?startingVerse=166","body":"So when they exceeded the limits of what they were prohibited, We said to them: \"Be you monkeys, despised and rejected.\" (It is a severe warning to the mankind that they should not disobey what Allah commands them to do, and be far away from what He prohibits them).","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-A'raaf","reference":"Ayah 166","secondaryText":"فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا۟ عَن مَّا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/21?startingVerse=109","body":"But if they (disbelievers, idolaters, Jews, Christians, polytheists, etc.) turn away (from Islamic Monotheism) say (to them O Muhammad SAW): \"I give you a notice (of war as) to be known to us all alike. And I know not whether that which you are promised (i.e. the torment or the Day of Resurrection) is near or far.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Anbiyaa","reference":"Ayah 109","secondaryText":"فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۢ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/73?startingVerse=18","body":"Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Muzzammil","reference":"Ayah 18","secondaryText":"ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/9?startingVerse=128","body":"Verily, there has come unto you a Messenger (Muhammad SAW) from amongst yourselves (i.e. whom you know well). It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty. He (Muhammad SAW) is anxious over you (to be rightly guided, to repent to Allah, and beg Him to pardon and forgive your sins, in order that you may enter Paradise and be saved from the punishment of the Hell-fire), for the believers (he SAW is) full of pity, kind, and merciful.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tawba","reference":"Ayah 128","secondaryText":"لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/20?startingVerse=130","body":"So bear patiently (O Muhammad SAW) what they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting, and during some of the hours of the night, and at the sides of the day (an indication for the five compulsory congregational prayers), that you may become pleased with the reward which Allah shall give you.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Taa-Haa","reference":"Ayah 130","secondaryText":"فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/18?startingVerse=45","body":"And put forward to them the example of the life of this world, it is like the water (rain) which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it, and becomes fresh and green. But (later) it becomes dry and broken pieces, which the winds scatter. And Allah is Able to do everything.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Kahf","reference":"Ayah 45","secondaryText":"وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًۭا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرًا"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/26?startingVerse=56","body":"\"But we are host all assembled, amply fore-warned.\"","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Ash-Shu'araa","reference":"Ayah 56","secondaryText":"وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/61?startingVerse=11","body":"That you believe in Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), and that you strive hard and fight in the Cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives, that will be better for you, if you but know!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah As-Saff","reference":"Ayah 11","secondaryText":"تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/34?startingVerse=15","body":"Indeed there was for Saba' (Sheba) a sign in their dwelling place, - two gardens on the right hand and on the left (and it was said to them) \"Eat of the provision of your Lord, and be grateful to Him, a fair land and an OftForgiving Lord.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Saba","reference":"Ayah 15","secondaryText":"لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍۢ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌۭ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍۢ وَشِمَالٍۢ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۚ بَلْدَةٌۭ طَيِّبَةٌۭ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌۭ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/52?startingVerse=30","body":"Or do they say: \"(Muhammad SAW is) a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah At-Tur","reference":"Ayah 30","secondaryText":"أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/2?startingVerse=262","body":"Those who spend their wealth in the Cause of Allah, and do not follow up their gifts with reminders of their generosity or with injury, their reward is with their Lord. On them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Al-Baqara","reference":"Ayah 262","secondaryText":"ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُتْبِعُونَ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ مَنًّۭا وَلَآ أَذًۭى ۙ لَّهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ"}

title: The Quran
data: {"url":"https://quran.com/31?startingVerse=25","body":"And if you (O Muhammad SAW) ask them: \"Who has created the heavens and the earth,\" they will certainly say: \"Allah.\" Say: \"All the praises and thanks be to Allah!\" But most of them know not.","book":"The Quran","author":"Al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan","format":"prose","source":"Surah Luqman","reference":"Ayah 25","secondaryText":"وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ"}

data: {"url":"https://quran.com/4?startingVerse=97","body":"Verily! title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Once we dreamt that we were strangers. We wake up to find that we were dear to each other.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"In my solitude of heart I feel the sigh of this widowed evening veiled with mist and rain.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"I cannot tell why this heart languishes in silence.\nIt is for small needs it never asks, or knows or remembers.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Darkness travels towards light, but blindness towards death.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

data: {"body":"To be outspoken is easy when you do not wait to speak the complete truth.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let life be beautiful like summer flowers and death like autumn leaves.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The sunshine greets me with a smile. The rain, his sad sister, talks to my heart.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"One word keep for me in thy silence, O World, when I am dead, \"I have loved.\"","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Man's history is waiting in patience for the triumph of the insulted man.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"In heart's perspective the distance looms large.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"There are tracts in my life that are bare and silent. They are the open spaces where my busy days had their light and air.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"I have dipped the vessel of my heart into this silent hour; it has filled with love.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Never be afraid of the moments--thus sings the voice of the everlasting.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

data: {"body":"Wrong cannot afford defeat but Right can.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"I have sung the songs of thy day. In the evening let me carry thy lamp through the stormy path.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The infant flower opens its bud and cries, \"Dear World, please do not fade.\"","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"God grows weary of great kingdoms, but never of little flowers.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The world has opened its heart of light in the morning.\nCome out, my heart, with thy love to meet it.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

data: {"body":"He who wants to do good knocks at the gate; he who loves finds the gate open.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The sun has his simple robe of light. The clouds are decked with gorgeousness.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Thoughts pass in my mind like flocks of ducks in the sky.\nI hear the voice of their wings.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let this be my last word, that I trust in thy love.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Our names are the light that glows on the sea waves at night and then dies without leaving its signature.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The power that boasts of its mischiefs is laughed at by the yellow leaves that fall, and clouds that pass by.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"When all the strings of my life will be tuned, my Master, then at every touch of thine will come out the music of love.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"I carry in my world that flourishes the worlds that have failed.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Truth seems to come with its final word; and the final word gives birth to its next.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Find your beauty, my heart, from the world's movement, like the boat that has the grace of the wind and the water.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Thought feeds itself with its own words and grows.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"I have suffered and despaired and known death and I am glad that I am in this great world.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Smoke boasts to the sky, and Ashes to the earth, that they are brothers to the fire.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The cricket's chirp and the patter of rain come to me through the dark, like the rustle of dreams from my past youth.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The fountain of death makes the still water of life play.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let your music, like a sword, pierce the noise of the market to its heart.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data:
{"body":""What language is thine, O sea?"

"The language of eternal question."

"What language is thy answer, O sky?

"The language of eternal silence."","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Around the sunny island of Life swells day and night death's limitless song of the sea.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"We read the world wrong and say that it deceives us.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"I do not ask thee into the house. Come into my infinite loneliness, my Lover.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Man goes into the noisy crowd to drown his own clamour of silence.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The night's silence, like a deep lamp, is burning with the light of its milky way.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"In death the many becomes one; in life the one becomes many. Religion will be one when God is dead.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"To-night there is a stir among the palm leaves, a swell in the sea, Full Moon, like the heart throb of the world. From what unknown sky hast thou carried in thy silence the aching secret of love?","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"God loves man's lamp lights better than his own great stars.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The lamp of meeting burns long; it goes out in a moment at the parting.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"God's right hand is gentle, but terrible is his left hand.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Woman, thou hast encircled the world's heart with the depth of thy tears as the sea has the earth.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"God expects answers for the flowers he sends us, not for the sun and the earth.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The leaf becomes flower when it loves.\nThe flower becomes fruit when it worships.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Set bird's wings with gold and it will never again soar in the sky.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"This sadness of my soul is her bride's veil.\nIt waits to be lifted in the night.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Death's stamp gives value to the coin of life; making it possible to buy with life what is truly precious.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Do not seat your love upon a precipice because it is high.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The bird wishes it were a cloud. The cloud wishes it were a bird.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The evening sky to me is like a window, and a lighted lamp, and a waiting behind it.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"This rainy evening the wind is restless.\nI look at the swaying branches and ponder over the greatness of all things.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Thank the flame for its light, but do not forget the lampholder standing in the shade with constancy of patience.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data:
{"body":"STRAY BIRDS

BY

RABINDRANATH TAGORE

[TRANSLATED FROM BENGALI TO ENGLISH BY THE AUTHOR]

1916","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The false can never grow into truth by growing in power.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"While the glass lamp rebukes the earthen for calling it cousin, the moon rises, and the glass lamp, with a bland smile, calls her, \"My dear, dear sister.\"","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"God comes to me in the dusk of my evening with the flowers from my past kept fresh in his basket.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let my doing nothing when I have nothing to do become untroubled in its depth of peace like the evening in the seashore when the water is silent.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The silent night has the beauty of the mother and the clamorous day of the child.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Love's pain sang round my life like the unplumbed sea, and love's joy sang like birds in its flowering groves.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let them live who choose in their own hissing world of fireworks.\nMy heart longs for thy stars, my God.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"\"Who drives me forward like fate?\" \"The Myself striding on my back.\"","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The movement of life has its rest in its own music.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let me live truly, my Lord, so that death to me become true.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The best does not come alone. It comes with the company of the all.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Let me feel this world as thy love taking form, then my love will help it.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The night kisses the fading day whispering to his ear, \"I am death, your mother. I am to give you fresh birth.\"","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Put out the lamp when thou wishest.\nI shall know thy darkness and shall love it.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The wasp thinks that the honey-hive of the neighbouring bees is too small.\nHis neighbours ask him to build one still smaller.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"The real with its meaning read wrong and emphasis misplaced is the unreal.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Bees sip honey from flowers and hum their thanks when they leave.\nThe gaudy butterfly is sure that the flowers owe thanks to him.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}

title: Stray Birds
data: {"body":"Night's darkness is a bag that bursts with the gold of the dawn.","book":"Stray Birds","author":"Rabindranath Tagore","format":"prose"}
